ko.title: 중간선거 이후: 새로운 세력 균형이 세금, 지출, 무역에 의미하는 바

segments.src: With the votes counted, the conversation in Washington shifts from campaigning to governing.
segments.tr: 개표가 완료되면서 워싱턴의 담론은 선거 운동에서 국정 운영으로 전환됩니다.

segments.src: Elections decide who holds the gavels, but the harder question is what the new Congress can actually pass, and what the president can do without it.
segments.tr: 선거는 누가 의사봉을 잡을지 결정하지만, 더 어려운 문제는 새 의회가 실제로 무엇을 통과시킬 수 있고, 의회 없이 대통령이 무엇을 할 수 있느냐입니다.

segments.src: This explainer walks through the main levers on the budget, tax policy and tariffs, and why the final shape of the new Congress matters so much for the next two years.
segments.tr: 이 해설서에서는 예산, 세제 정책, 관세의 핵심 수단들과 함께, 새 의회의 최종 구도가 향후 2년간 왜 그토록 중요한지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: *Note: Final margins, especially in closely divided chambers, can take time to settle.
segments.tr: *참고: 의석수가 팽팽하게 갈린 의회의 경우 최종 격차가 확정되기까지 시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This article focuses on how the process works rather than on predictions, and readers should check official results for the latest seat counts.*
segments.tr: 본 기사는 예측보다는 절차가 작동하는 방식에 초점을 맞추며, 독자 여러분은 최신 의석수를 확인하기 위해 공식 결과 조회를 활용하셔야 합니다.*

segments.src: ## Why the Balance of Power Matters
segments.tr: ## 세력 균형이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Most major economic policy in the United States requires agreement among three parties: the House, the Senate and the White House.
segments.tr: 미국의 주요 경제 정책 대부분은 하원, 상원, 백악관이라는 세 주체 간의 합의를 필요로 합니다.

segments.src: When one party controls all three, legislation can move relatively quickly, though narrow margins still give small groups of lawmakers real leverage.
segments.tr: 한 정당이 세 곳을 모두 통과하면 입법이 비교적 빠르게 진행될 수 있지만, 근소한 의석 차이는 소수 의원 그룹에 실질적인 영향력을 부여합니다.

segments.src: When control is split, the typical result is negotiation, delay or gridlock, and a greater reliance on executive action and must-pass deadlines.
segments.tr: 권력이 분할되면 일반적인 결과는 협상, 지연 또는 교착 상태이며, 행정 조치 및 필착 마감 시한에 대한 의존도가 높아집니다.

segments.src: Three details often matter more than the headline result:
segments.tr: 헤드라인 결과보다 다음의 세 가지 세부 사항이 종종 더 중요합니다.

segments.src: - **The size of the margin.** A majority of a few seats is hard to manage, because a handful of absences or defections can sink a bill.
segments.tr: - **격차의 크기.** 몇 의석 차이에 불과한 다수당은 관리가 어려운데, 소수의 이탈이나 불참만으로도 법안이 무산될 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: - **The Senate filibuster.** Most legislation needs 60 votes to advance in the Senate, which forces bipartisan deals unless a bill qualifies for a special process.
segments.tr: - **상원 필리버스터.** 상원에서 대부분의 법안이 통과하려면 60표가 필요하므로, 특별 절차에 해당하지 않는 한 초당적 합의가 강제됩니다.

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Whoever chairs the Ways and Means, Finance, Appropriations and Budget committees helps set the agenda, schedule hearings and shape the text of bills.
segments.tr: - **위원회 위원장직.** 세입위원회, 재무위원회, 예결위원회 및 예산위원회의 위원장을 맡는 인물이 의제를 설정하고 청문회를 일정에 잡으며 법안 조문을 작성하는 데 기여합니다.

segments.src: ## The Budget and Government Funding
segments.tr: ## 예산과 정부 자금 지원

segments.src: Congress must pass appropriations bills each year to fund federal agencies.
segments.tr: 의회는 연방 기관에 자금을 지원하기 위해 매년 예산안을 통과시켜야 합니다.

segments.src: When it fails to do so by the start of the fiscal year on October 1, it typically passes a short-term "continuing resolution" to keep the government open, or risks a partial shutdown.
segments.tr: 회계연도가 시작되는 10월 1일까지 이를 완료하지 못하면 정부 셧다운을 막기 위해 단기 "임시지출결의안(continuing resolution)"을 통과시키거나 부분 셧다운 위험을 무릅써야 합니다.

segments.src: ### What to watch
segments.tr: ### 주시해야 할 사항

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **예산안 협상.** 하원과 상원은 국방 및 비국방 프로그램의 지출 수준에 합의해야 합니다. 분열된 의회는 종종 임시방편적 조치와 마감 시한 임박 후의 대규모 일과 타결 패키지를 의미합니다.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **부채 상한선.** 의회는 재무부가 이미 발생한 채무를 지불할 수 있도록 차입 상한선을 주기적으로 증액하거나 유예해야 합니다. 이러한 투표는 광범위한 예산 협상의 계기가 반복적으로 되어왔습니다.

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **의무 지출과 적자.** 사회보장, 메디케어, 메디케이드는 연방 지출의 큰 비중을 차지하며, 국채에 대한 이자 비용도 증가했습니다. 이러한 프로그램을 변경하려는 제안은 정치적으로 어려우며 광범위한 합의 없이는 추진되기 힘듭니다.

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **예산 조정 절차(Budget reconciliation).** 이 절차를 통해 상원은 필리버스터를 피하고 단순 과반수로 특정 세금 및 지출 조치를 통과시킬 수 있습니다. 포괄할 수 있는 내용에 대한 엄격한 규칙이 적용되며, 매년 특정 주제에 대해 제한된 횟수만큼만 사용할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## 세제 정책

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: 향후 2년간의 세금 논쟁은 어떤 조항이 변경될 예정인지, 그리고 의원들이 얼마나 그것을 수정하고 싶어하는지에 의해 결정될 것입니다.

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: 세법에는 정해진 날짜에 만료되는 일몰 조항이 많이 포함되어 있어 의회에 자연스러운 결정 시점을 제공합니다.

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### 핵심 질문

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **연장 및 일몰.** 세제 조항 세트가 만료될 때마다 의원들은 연장할지, 수정할지, 혹은 소멸시킬지를 결정해야 합니다. 각 선택은 가계의 실수령액과 기업의 계획에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **비용과 재원 조달.** 감세는 지출 감축이나 기타 세수 증가로 상쇄되지 않는 한 연방 세수를 줄입니다. 비당파적 의회예산처(CBO)와 합동조세위원회(JCT)를 포함한 의회 평가 기관들은 이러한 비용을 추정하며, 이들의 숫자가 논쟁의 향방을 좌우하곤 합니다.

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **선별적 공제 및 감면.** 아동 관련 공제, 기업 비용 처리 또는 에너지 인센티브 변경과 같은 소규모 초당적 제안은 전면적인 개편보다 팽팽하게 갈린 의회에서 통과될 가능성이 더 높습니다.

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **절차적 한계.** 초당적 지지가 없는 주요 세제 법안은 일반적으로 조정 절차에 의존하며, 이는 포함될 수 있는 내용을 좁힙니다.

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: 가계와 소상공인을 위한 실질적인 조언은 단순 제안보다는 실제로 제정된 법률을 따르는 것입니다.

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: 선거 운동 기간 동안 논의된 대부분의 아이디어는 원래 형태 그대로 법제화되지 않습니다.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## 관세 및 무역

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: 무역 정책은 행정부가 상당한 권한을 보유하고 있다는 점에서 이례적입니다.

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: 의회는 관세와 통상에 관한 헌법상 권한을 가지고 있지만, 여러 법률을 통해 그 권한의 상당 부분을 대통령에게 위임했습니다.

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: 결과적으로 관세 정책은 세제나 지출 정책보다 빠르게 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### 의회가 무역에 여전히 영향을 미치는 방법

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **감독.** 상임위원회는 관세의 비용과 영향에 대해 청문회를 개최하고, 문서를 요청하며, 당국자들에게 질의할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **입법.** 의원들은 무역 조치를 제한, 조건화 또는 법제화하는 법안을 발의할 수 있지만, 이러한 조치는 대통령의 거부권 행사에 직면할 수 있으며 이를 거부하려면 양원에서 3분의 2의 찬성이 필요합니다.

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **무역 협정.** 의회는 특정 무역 협정을 승인하거나 이행하고 무역 규정을 집행하는 기관에 자금을 지원하는 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **법원.** 행정부의 관세 권한 범위에 대한 법적 소송 역시 의회 표결과 무관하게 결과를 좌우할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Tariffs are paid at the border by importers, and the costs can be passed along to businesses and consumers in different ways.
segments.tr: 관세는 국경에서 수입업자가 납부하며, 그 비용은 다양한 방식으로 기업과 소비자에게 전가될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Economists generally disagree about how large the effects are and who bears them, which is one reason trade debates remain heated.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 영향의 크기와 부담 주체에 대해 일반적으로 의견이 일치하지 않으며, 이는 무역 논쟁이 격렬하게 유지되는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## How the Scenarios Differ
segments.tr: ## 시나리오별 차이점

segments.src: | Scenario | Likely dynamics |
segments.tr: | 시나리오 | 예상 역학 관계 |

segments.src: | One party controls both chambers and the White House | Faster legislative action is possible, especially through reconciliation, but narrow margins can still stall bills |
segments.tr: | 한 정당이 양원과 백악관을 모두 장악 | 특히 예산 조정을 통한 신속한 입법 조치가 가능하지만, 근소한 격차로 인해 법안이 지연될 수 있음 |

segments.src: | Split Congress | More negotiation, more stopgap measures, more oversight hearings, and fewer sweeping laws |
segments.tr: | 양원 분할 의회 | 더 많은 협상, 더 많은 임시 조치, 더 많은 감독 청문회, 그리고 전면적인 법률 제정 감소 |

segments.src: | Divided government (White House and Congress controlled by different parties) | Greater use of the veto, executive action and confrontation over deadlines |
segments.tr: | 분할 정부 (백악관과 의회를 서로 다른 정당이 장악) | 거부권 행사, 행정 조치 및 마감 시한에 따른 대립 증가 |

segments.src: ## Key Dates and Deadlines to Watch
segments.tr: ## 주시해야 할 주요 날짜 및 마감 시한

segments.src: - **New Congress convenes in January**, when members are sworn in and leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: - **1월 새 의회 개원**, 의원들의 선서 및 지도부 선출 진행.

segments.src: - **Committee assignments and chairs** are set early in the session.
segments.tr: - **위원회 배정 및 위원장 선임**은 회기 초기에 확정.

segments.src: - **Funding deadlines** arrive on a recurring annual schedule.
segments.tr: - **예산 지원 마감 시한**은 매년 반복되는 일정에 따라 도래.

segments.src: - **Expiring provisions** in tax and other laws create windows for negotiation.
segments.tr: - 세법 및 기타 법률의 **일몰 조항**은 협상의 기회를 창출.

segments.src: - **The next election cycle** begins almost immediately and can affect how willing lawmakers are to compromise.
segments.tr: - **다음 선거 주기**가 즉시 시작되어 의원들의 타협 의지에 영향을 미칠 수 있음.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Readers
segments.tr: ## 이것이 독자들에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: - **Households:** Changes to taxes or benefits only matter once they are signed into law and take effect. Watch for effective dates and consult official guidance or a qualified tax professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: - **가계:** 세금이나 혜택의 변경은 법안으로 서명되고 발효된 후에만 의미가 있습니다. 재정적 결정을 내리기 전에 시행일을 확인하고 공식 지침이나 자격을 갖춘 세무 전문가와 상담하세요.

segments.src: - **Small businesses:** Tariff changes and tax provisions can affect costs and planning. Keep an eye on announcements from the relevant agencies.
segments.tr: - **소상공인:** 관세 변화와 세제 조항은 비용과 계획에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 관련 기관의 발표를 계속 주시하세요.

segments.src: - **Investors and savers:** Political events can move markets in the short term, but long-term outcomes depend on many factors. This article is not investment advice.
segments.tr: - **투자자 및 저축가:** 정치적 사건은 단기적으로 시장을 움직일 수 있지만, 장기적 결과는 다양한 요인에 달려 있습니다. 본 기사는 투자 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: The election determines who sits at the table, but the rules of the Senate, the size of the margins and the calendar of deadlines determine what can actually get done.
segments.tr: 선거는 누가 테이블에 앉을지를 결정하지만, 상원의 규칙, 의석수 격차의 크기, 마감 시한의 일정에 따라 실제로 추진될 수 있는 일이 결정됩니다.

segments.src: Expect big promises to be narrowed by procedure, and expect some of the most consequential decisions, particularly on trade, to come from executive action as much as from legislation.
segments.tr: 거창한 공약들은 절차에 의해 축소될 것으로 예상되며, 특히 무역에 관한 가장 중대한 결정 중 일부는 입법 못지않게 행정 조치에서 나올 것임을 예상해야 합니다.

segments.src: The most reliable way to follow the story is to track specific bills, committee actions and official deadlines as they happen.
segments.tr: 이 이슈를 팔로우하는 가장 확실한 방법은 특정 법안, 위원회 활동 및 공식 마감 시한을 일어나는 대로 추적하는 것입니다.

zh.title: 中期选举之后：新的权力格局对税收、支出和贸易意味着什么

segments.src: With the votes counted, the conversation in Washington shifts from campaigning to governing.
segments.tr: 随着选票计票完毕，华盛顿的焦点从竞选转向了施政。

segments.src: Elections decide who holds the gavels, but the harder question is what the new Congress can actually pass, and what the president can do without it.
segments.tr: 选举决定了谁掌握木槌，但更难的问题在于新一届国会究竟能通过什么，以及总统在没有国会支持的情况下能做些什么。

segments.src: This explainer walks through the main levers on the budget, tax policy and tariffs, and why the final shape of the new Congress matters so much for the next two years.
segments.tr: 本篇解释性文章梳理了预算、税收政策和关税方面的核心杠杆，以及为什么新一届国会的最终格局对未来两年至关重要。

segments.src: *Note: Final margins, especially in closely divided chambers, can take time to settle.
segments.tr: *注：最终的议席优势差距，特别是在席位接近的议院中，可能需要时间才能确定。

segments.src: This article focuses on how the process works rather than on predictions, and readers should check official results for the latest seat counts.*
segments.tr: 本文侧重于解释流程如何运作而非做出预测，读者应查阅官方结果以获取最新的席位统计。*

segments.src: ## Why the Balance of Power Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么权力格局如此重要

segments.src: Most major economic policy in the United States requires agreement among three parties: the House, the Senate and the White House.
segments.tr: 在美国，绝大多数重大经济政策都需要三方的同意：众议院、参议院和白宫。

segments.src: When one party controls all three, legislation can move relatively quickly, though narrow margins still give small groups of lawmakers real leverage.
segments.tr: 当一个政党同时控制这三者时，立法可以相对快速地推进，尽管微弱的席位优势仍会让一小部分议员掌握实质性的杠杆。

segments.src: When control is split, the typical result is negotiation, delay or gridlock, and a greater reliance on executive action and must-pass deadlines.
segments.tr: 当控制权被分立时，通常的结果是谈判、拖延或僵局，以及更加依赖行政行动和必须通过的法案截止日期。

segments.src: Three details often matter more than the headline result:
segments.tr: 有三个细节往往比头条新闻的结果更关键：

segments.src: - **The size of the margin.** A majority of a few seats is hard to manage, because a handful of absences or defections can sink a bill.
segments.tr: - **席位优势的大小。** 仅领先几个席位的多数优势很难管理，因为少数几名议员的缺席或倒戈就可能击沉一项法案。

segments.src: - **The Senate filibuster.** Most legislation needs 60 votes to advance in the Senate, which forces bipartisan deals unless a bill qualifies for a special process.
segments.tr: - **参议院的冗长议事（Filibuster）。** 大多数立法需要 60 票才能在参议院推进，除非法案符合特殊程序的条件，否则这会强迫两党达成妥协。

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Whoever chairs the Ways and Means, Finance, Appropriations and Budget committees helps set the agenda, schedule hearings and shape the text of bills.
segments.tr: - **委员会的领导权。** 担任筹款委员会、金融委员会、拨款委员会和预算委员会主席的人有助于设定议程、安排听证会并塑造法案文本。

segments.src: ## The Budget and Government Funding
segments.tr: ## 预算与政府拨款

segments.src: Congress must pass appropriations bills each year to fund federal agencies.
segments.tr: 国会每年必须通过拨款法案来资助联邦机构。

segments.src: When it fails to do so by the start of the fiscal year on October 1, it typically passes a short-term "continuing resolution" to keep the government open, or risks a partial shutdown.
segments.tr: 如果在 10 月 1 日新财政年度开始前未能做到这一点，它通常会通过一项短期“持续决议”（continuing resolution）以维持政府运转，否则将面临局部停摆的风险。

segments.src: ### What to watch
segments.tr: ### 值得关注的要点

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **拨款谈判。** 众议院和参议院必须就国防和非国防项目的支出水平达成一致。分立的国会往往意味着在截止日期临近时采取临时过渡措施和打包大型综合法案。

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **债务上限。** 国会必须定期提高或暂停借款上限，以便财政部能够支付已经产生的义务。这些投票一再成为更广泛预算博弈的契机。

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **法定福利与赤字。** 社会保障（Social Security）、医疗保险（Medicare）和医疗补助（Medicaid）占联邦支出的很大一部分，且国债的利息成本也在增长。修改这些计划的提议在政治上非常困难，在没有广泛共识的情况下很少能推进。

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **预算和解程序（Budget reconciliation）。** 该程序允许参议院以简单多数通过特定的税收和支出措施，从而绕过冗长议事。它附带关于可包含内容的严格规则，并且每年在给定主题上只能使用有限的次数。

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## 税收政策

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: 未来两年的税收辩论将由哪些条款预定发生变更以及立法者希望在多大程度上改变它们来决定。

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: 税法包含许多在特定日期到期的临时条款，这为国会创造了天然的决策节点。

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### 关键问题

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **延期与到期。** 每当一套税收条款即将到期时，立法者必须决定是延长、修改还是任其失效。每种选择都会影响家庭的实拿薪水和企业规划。

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **成本与对冲。** 减税会减少联邦收入，除非有支出减少或其他收入来对冲。包括无党派的国会预算办公室（CBO）和税收联合委员会在内的国会打分机构会对这些成本进行估算，他们的数字往往会塑造辩论走向。

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **定向税收抵免与扣除。** 与全面改革相比，较小的两党提议（如针对儿童抵免额、企业费用扣除或能源激励措施的修改）在席位接近的国会中更有可能获得通过。

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **程序限制。** 没有两党支持的重大税收法案通常依赖于预算和解程序，而这缩小了可纳入法案的内容范围。

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: 对于家庭和小企业来说，实用的建议是关注实际颁布的立法，而不是提案。

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: 竞选期间讨论的大多数想法永远不会以其原始形式成为法律。

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## 关税与贸易

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: 贸易政策比较特殊，因为行政部门拥有相当大的权力。

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: 国会宪法上拥有针对关税和对外商业的权力，但它已通过多项法规将这些权力的大部分授权给了总统。

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: 因此，关税政策的改变速度可以快于税收或支出政策。

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### 国会依然如何影响贸易

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **监督。** 委员会可以举行听证会、索取文件并就关税的成本和影响质询官员。

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **立法。** 立法者可以提出法案来限制、约束或成文法化贸易行动，尽管此类措施面临总统否决的可能，否决需要两院三分之二的赞成票才能翻盘。

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **贸易协定。** 国会在批准或实施某些贸易协定以及资助执行贸易规则的机构方面发挥着作用。

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **法院。** 针对行政关税权力范围的法律挑战也可以决定最终结果，这独立于国会的任何投票。

segments.src: Tariffs are paid at the border by importers, and the costs can be passed along to businesses and consumers in different ways.
segments.tr: 关税是由进口商在边境缴纳的，其成本可以通过不同方式转嫁给企业和消费者。

segments.src: Economists generally disagree about how large the effects are and who bears them, which is one reason trade debates remain heated.
segments.tr: 经济学家通常对影响程度有多大以及谁来承担这些影响存在分歧，这也是贸易辩论持续升温的原因之一。

segments.src: ## How the Scenarios Differ
segments.tr: ## 不同场景有何区别

segments.src: | Scenario | Likely dynamics |
segments.tr: | 场景 | 可能的动态 |

segments.src: | One party controls both chambers and the White House | Faster legislative action is possible, especially through reconciliation, but narrow margins can still stall bills |
segments.tr: | 一党同时控制两院和白宫 | 更有可能实现更快的立法行动，特别是通过预算和解程序，但微弱的优势仍可能拖累法案 |

segments.src: | Split Congress | More negotiation, more stopgap measures, more oversight hearings, and fewer sweeping laws |
segments.tr: | 国会分立 | 更多的谈判、更多的过渡措施、更多的监督听证会，以及更少的全面法律 |

segments.src: | Divided government (White House and Congress controlled by different parties) | Greater use of the veto, executive action and confrontation over deadlines |
segments.tr: | 分立政府（白宫与国会由不同政党控制） | 更多地使用否决权、行政行动以及围绕截止日期的对抗 |

segments.src: ## Key Dates and Deadlines to Watch
segments.tr: ## 值得关注的关键日期与截止时间

segments.src: - **New Congress convenes in January**, when members are sworn in and leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: - **新一届国会于 1 月开幕**，届时议员宣誓就职并选出领导人。

segments.src: - **Committee assignments and chairs** are set early in the session.
segments.tr: - **委员会分配与主席人选**在会期初期确定。

segments.src: - **Funding deadlines** arrive on a recurring annual schedule.
segments.tr: - **拨款截止日期**按年度周期定期到来。

segments.src: - **Expiring provisions** in tax and other laws create windows for negotiation.
segments.tr: - 税收和其他法律中的**到期条款**为谈判创造了窗口期。

segments.src: - **The next election cycle** begins almost immediately and can affect how willing lawmakers are to compromise.
segments.tr: - **下一个选举周期**几乎立即开始，并可能影响立法者妥协的意愿。

segments.src: ## What This Means for Readers
segments.tr: ## 这对读者意味着什么

segments.src: - **Households:** Changes to taxes or benefits only matter once they are signed into law and take effect. Watch for effective dates and consult official guidance or a qualified tax professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: - **家庭：** 税收或福利的变化只有在签署成为法律并生效后才有实质意义。在做出财务决定前，请关注生效日期并咨询官方指导或有资质的税务专业人士。

segments.src: - **Small businesses:** Tariff changes and tax provisions can affect costs and planning. Keep an eye on announcements from the relevant agencies.
segments.tr: - **小企业：** 关税变化和税收条款会影响成本和规划。密切关注相关机构发布的公告。

segments.src: - **Investors and savers:** Political events can move markets in the short term, but long-term outcomes depend on many factors. This article is not investment advice.
segments.tr: - **投资者与储蓄者：** 政治事件可能会在短期内影响市场，但长期结果取决于多种因素。本文不构成投资建议。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The election determines who sits at the table, but the rules of the Senate, the size of the margins and the calendar of deadlines determine what can actually get done.
segments.tr: 选举决定了谁坐在谈判桌前，但参议院的规则、席位优势的大小以及日程表上的截止日期决定了实际上能完成什么。

segments.src: Expect big promises to be narrowed by procedure, and expect some of the most consequential decisions, particularly on trade, to come from executive action as much as from legislation.
segments.tr: 预计宏伟的许诺会被程序所缩小，并预计一些最具影响力的决定（特别是在贸易方面）在很大程度上将同样来自于行政行动而非立法。

segments.src: The most reliable way to follow the story is to track specific bills, committee actions and official deadlines as they happen.
segments.tr: 跟踪这一进程最可靠的方法，是关注具体法案的推进、委员会的行动以及官方截止日期的实时动态。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成法律、税务或财务建议。*

segments.src: ## Why the Balance of Power Matters
segments.tr: ## सत्ता का संतुलन क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है

segments.src: Most major economic policy in the United States requires agreement among three parties: the House, the Senate and the White House.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राष्ट्र में अधिकांश प्रमुख आर्थिक नीति के लिए तीन पक्षों के बीच समझौते की आवश्यकता होती है: हाउस, सीनेट और व्हाइट हाउस।

segments.src: When one party controls all three, legislation can move relatively quickly, though narrow margins still give small groups of lawmakers real leverage.
segments.tr: जब एक पार्टी तीनों को नियंत्रित करती है, तो कानून अपेक्षाकृत जल्दी आगे बढ़ सकता है, हालांकि संकीर्ण मार्जिन अभी भी छोटे समूहों के कानून निर्माताओं को वास्तविक लाभ देते हैं।

segments.src: When control is split, the typical result is negotiation, delay or gridlock, and a greater reliance on executive action and must-pass deadlines.
segments.tr: जब नियंत्रण विभाजित होता है, तो सामान्य परिणाम बातचीत, देरी या गतिरोध होता है, और कार्यकारी कार्रवाई और अवश्य पारित होने वाली समय सीमा पर अधिक निर्भरता होती है।

segments.src: Three details often matter more than the headline result:
segments.tr: तीन विवरण अक्सर मुख्य समाचार परिणाम से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण होते हैं:

segments.src: - **The size of the margin.** A majority of a few seats is hard to manage, because a handful of absences or defections can sink a bill.
segments.tr: - **मार्जिन का आकार।** कुछ सीटों का बहुमत संभालना कठिन है, क्योंकि मुट्ठीभर अनुपस्थिति या दलबदल एक विधेयक को डुबो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **The Senate filibuster.** Most legislation needs 60 votes to advance in the Senate, which forces bipartisan deals unless a bill qualifies for a special process.
segments.tr: - **सीनेट फिलिबस्टर।** सीनेट में आगे बढ़ने के लिए अधिकांश कानून को 60 वोटों की आवश्यकता होती है, जो द्विपक्षीय सौदों को मजबूर करता है जब तक कि कोई विधेयक विशेष प्रक्रिया के लिए योग्य न हो।

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Whoever chairs the Ways and Means, Finance, Appropriations and Budget committees helps set the agenda, schedule hearings and shape the text of bills.
segments.tr: - **समिति का नेतृत्व।** जो कोई भी वेज एंड मीन्स, फाइनेंस, एप्रोप్రియेशन और बजट समितियों की अध्यक्षता करता है, वह एजेंडा तय करने, सुनवाई निर्धारित करने और विधेयकों के पाठ को आकार देने में मदद करता है।

segments.src: ## The Budget and Government Funding
segments.tr: ## बजट और सरकार का वित्तपोषण

segments.src: Congress must pass appropriations bills each year to fund federal agencies.
segments.tr: संघीय एजेंसियों को निधि देने के लिए कांग्रेस को हर साल विनियोग विधेयक पारित करना होगा।

segments.src: When it fails to do so by the start of the fiscal year on October 1, it typically passes a short-term "continuing resolution" to keep the government open, or risks a partial shutdown.
segments.tr: जब यह 1 अक्टूबर को वित्तीय वर्ष की शुरुआत तक ऐसा करने में विफल रहता है, तो यह आमतौर पर सरकार को खुला रखने के लिए अल्पकालिक "निरंतर संकल्प" पारित करता है, या आंशिक शटडाउन का जोखिम उठाता है।

segments.src: ### What to watch
segments.tr: ### क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **विनियोग वार्ता।** हाउस और सीनेट को रक्षा और गैर-रक्षा कार्यक्रमों के लिए खर्च के स्तर पर सहमत होना चाहिए। एक विभाजित कांग्रेस का अक्सर मतलब स्टॉपगैप उपाय और समय सीमा के पास बड़े संयुक्त पैकेज होते हैं।

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **ऋण सीमा।** समय-समय पर, कांग्रेस को उधार लेने की सीमा को बढ़ाना या निलंबित करना होगा ताकि ट्रेजरी पहले से किए गए दायित्वों का भुगतान कर सके। ये वोट बार-बार व्यापक बजट सौदेबाजी के अवसर बन गए हैं।

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **हकदारी और घाटा।** सामाजिक सुरक्षा, मेडिकेयर और मेडिकेड संघीय खर्च का एक बड़ा हिस्सा बनाते हैं, और राष्ट्रीय ऋण पर ब्याज लागत बढ़ गई है। इन कार्यक्रमों को बदलने के प्रस्ताव राजनीतिक रूप से कठिन हैं और व्यापक समझौते के बिना शायद ही कभी आगे बढ़ते हैं।

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **बजट सुलह।** यह प्रक्रिया सीनेट को फिलिबस्टर से बचते हुए साधारण बहुमत के साथ कुछ कर और खर्च के उपायों को पारित करने देती है। यह इस बात पर सख्त नियमों के साथ आता है कि क्या शामिल किया जा सकता है, और इसका उपयोग हर साल किसी दिए गए विषय पर सीमित संख्या में ही किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## कर नीति

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: अगले दो वर्षों में कर बहस इस बात से आकार लेगी कि कौन से प्रावधान बदलने के लिए निर्धारित हैं और कानून निर्माता उन्हें कितना बदलना चाहते हैं।

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: कर कानून में कई अस्थायी प्रावधान शामिल हैं जो निर्धारित तिथियों पर समाप्त होते हैं, जो कांग्रेस के लिए प्राकृतिक निर्णय बिंदु बनाते हैं।

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### मुख्य प्रश्न

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **विस्तार और समाप्ति।** जब भी कर प्रावधानों का एक सेट समाप्त होने वाला होता है, तो कानून निर्माताओं को यह तय करना होगा कि उन्हें बढ़ाया जाए, संशोधित किया जाए या समाप्त होने दिया जाए। प्रत्येक विकल्प घरेलू टेक-होम पे और व्यावसायिक योजना को प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **लागत और ऑफसेट।** कर कटौती से संघीय राजस्व कम हो जाता है जब तक कि उन्हें खर्च में कमी या अन्य राजस्व द्वारा ऑफसेट नहीं किया जाता है। गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण कांग्रेसी बजट कार्यालय और कराधान पर संयुक्त समिति सहित कांग्रेसी स्कोरकीपर, इन लागतों का अनुमान लगाते हैं, और उनके नंबर अक्सर बहस को आकार देते हैं।

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **लक्षित क्रेडिट और कटौती।** छोटे, द्विपक्षीय प्रस्ताव, जैसे बाल-संबंधी क्रेडिट, व्यावसायिक व्यय या ऊर्जा प्रोत्साहन में परिवर्तन, व्यापक संशोधनों की तुलना में निकटता से विभाजित कांग्रेस में पारित होने की अधिक संभावना है।

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **प्रक्रिया सीमाएं।** द्विपक्षीय समर्थन के बिना एक प्रमुख कर विधेयक आम तौर पर सुलह पर निर्भर करता है, जो इस बात को सीमित करता है कि क्या शामिल किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: घरों और छोटे व्यवसायों के लिए, व्यावहारिक सलाह प्रस्तावों के बजाय वास्तविक अधिनियमित कानून का पालन करना है।

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: अभियान के दौरान चर्चा किए गए अधिकांश विचार अपने मूल रूप में कभी कानून नहीं बनते हैं।

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## टैरिफ और व्यापार

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: व्यापार नीति असामान्य है क्योंकि कार्यकारी शाखा के पास महत्वपूर्ण अधिकार हैं।

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस के पास टैरिफ और विदेशी वाणिज्य पर संवैधानिक शक्ति है, लेकिन उसने कई कानूनों के माध्यम से उस शक्ति का एक बड़ा हिस्सा राष्ट्रपति को सौंप दिया है।

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: परिणामस्वरूप, टैरिफ नीति कर या खर्च नीति की तुलना में तेजी से बदल सकती है।

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### कांग्रेस अभी भी व्यापार को कैसे प्रभावित कर सकती है

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **निगरानी।** समितियां सुनवाई आयोजित कर सकती हैं, दस्तावेज अनुरोध कर सकती हैं और टैरिफ की लागत और प्रभावों के बारे में अधिकारियों से सवाल कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **कानून।** कानून निर्माता व्यापार कार्यों को सीमित करने, शर्त लगाने या संहिताबद्ध करने के लिए विधेयक प्रस्तावित कर सकते हैं, हालांकि ऐसे उपायों को संभावित राष्ट्रपति वीटो का सामना करना पड़ता है, जिसे ओवरराइड करने के लिए दोनों सदनों में दो-तिहाई वोट की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **व्यापार समझौते।** कांग्रेस के पास कुछ व्यापार सौदों को मंजूरी देने या लागू करने और व्यापार नियमों को लागू करने वाली एजेंसियों को निधि देने में भूमिका है।

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **अदालतें।** कार्यकारी टैरिफ प्राधिकरण के दायरे पर कानूनी चुनौतियां भी कांग्रेस में किसी भी वोट से स्वतंत्र, परिणामों को आकार दे सकती हैं।

segments.src: Tariffs are paid at the border by importers, and the costs can be passed along to businesses and consumers in different ways.
segments.tr: टैरिफ आयातकों द्वारा सीमा पर भुगतान किए जाते हैं, और लागत विभिन्न तरीकों से व्यवसायों और उपभोक्ताओं तक पहुंचाई जा सकती है।

segments.src: Economists generally disagree about how large the effects are and who bears them, which is one reason trade debates remain heated.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री आम तौर पर इस बात से असहमत हैं कि प्रभाव कितने बड़े हैं और कौन उन्हें सहन करता है, यही एक कारण है कि व्यापार बहस गर्म बनी हुई है।

segments.src: ## How the Scenarios Differ
segments.tr: ## परिदृश्य कैसे भिन्न होते हैं

segments.src: | Scenario | Likely dynamics |
segments.tr: | परिदृश्य | संभावित गतिशीलता |

segments.src: | One party controls both chambers and the White House | Faster legislative action is possible, especially through reconciliation, but narrow margins can still stall bills |
segments.tr: | एक पार्टी दोनों सदनों और व्हाइट हाउस को नियंत्रित करती है | तेजी से विधायी कार्रवाई संभव है, विशेष रूप से सुलह के माध्यम से, लेकिन संकीर्ण मार्जिन अभी भी विधेयकों को रोक सकते हैं |

segments.src: | Split Congress | More negotiation, more stopgap measures, more oversight hearings, and fewer sweeping laws |
segments.tr: | विभाजित कांग्रेस | अधिक बातचीत, अधिक स्टॉपगैप उपाय, अधिक निगरानी सुनवाई, और कम व्यापक कानून |

segments.src: | Divided government (White House and Congress controlled by different parties) | Greater use of the veto, executive action and confrontation over deadlines |
segments.tr: | विभाजित सरकार (व्हाइट हाउस और कांग्रेस विभिन्न दलों द्वारा नियंत्रित) | वीटो का अधिक उपयोग, कार्यकारी कार्रवाई और समय सीमा पर टकराव |

segments.src: ## Key Dates and Deadlines to Watch
segments.tr: ## देखने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण तिथियां और समय सीमा

segments.src: - **New Congress convenes in January**, when members are sworn in and leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: - **नई कांग्रेस जनवरी में मिलती है**, जब सदस्यों को शपथ दिलाई जाती है और नेताओं को चुना जाता है।

segments.src: - **Committee assignments and chairs** are set early in the session.
segments.tr: - **समिति के असाइनमेंट और अध्यक्ष** सत्र की शुरुआत में सेट किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Funding deadlines** arrive on a recurring annual schedule.
segments.tr: - **वित्तपोषण समय सीमा** आवर्ती वार्षिक अनुसूची पर आती है।

segments.src: - **Expiring provisions** in tax and other laws create windows for negotiation.
segments.tr: - कर और अन्य कानूनों में **समाप्त होने वाले प्रावधान** बातचीत के लिए खिड़कियां बनाते हैं।

segments.src: - **The next election cycle** begins almost immediately and can affect how willing lawmakers are to compromise.
segments.tr: - **अगला चुनाव चक्र** लगभग तुरंत शुरू होता है और इस बात को प्रभावित कर सकता है कि कानून निर्माता समझौता करने के लिए कितने उत्सुक हैं।

segments.src: ## What This Means for Readers
segments.tr: ## पाठकों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: - **Households:** Changes to taxes or benefits only matter once they are signed into law and take effect. Watch for effective dates and consult official guidance or a qualified tax professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: - **परिवार:** करों या लाभों में परिवर्तन तभी मायने रखता है जब वे कानून में हस्ताक्षरित होते हैं और प्रभावी होते हैं। वित्तीय निर्णय लेने से पहले प्रभावी तिथियों को देखें और आधिकारिक मार्गदर्शन या योग्य कर पेशेवर से परामर्श लें।

segments.src: - **Small businesses:** Tariff changes and tax provisions can affect costs and planning. Keep an eye on announcements from the relevant agencies.
segments.tr: - **छोटे व्यवसाय:** टैरिफ परिवर्तन और कर प्रावधान लागत और योजना को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं। प्रासंगिक एजेंसियों की घोषणाओं पर नजर रखें।

segments.src: - **Investors and savers:** Political events can move markets in the short term, but long-term outcomes depend on many factors. This article is not investment advice.
segments.tr: - **निवेशक और बचतकर्ता:** राजनीतिक घटनाएं अल्पावधि में बाजारों को स्थानांतरित कर सकती हैं, लेकिन दीर्घकालिक परिणाम कई कारकों पर निर्भर करते हैं। यह लेख निवेश सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: The election determines who sits at the table, but the rules of the Senate, the size of the margins and the calendar of deadlines determine what can actually get done.
segments.tr: चुनाव यह निर्धारित करता है कि मेज पर कौन बैठता है, लेकिन सीनेट के नियम, मार्जिन का आकार और समय सीमा का कैलेंडर यह निर्धारित करता है कि वास्तव में क्या किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Expect big promises to be narrowed by procedure, and expect some of the most consequential decisions, particularly on trade, to come from executive action as much as from legislation.
segments.tr: प्रक्रिया द्वारा बड़े वादों को संकीर्ण किए जाने की अपेक्षा करें, और कुछ सबसे महत्वपूर्ण निर्णयों, विशेष रूप से व्यापार पर, कानून के साथ-साथ कार्यकारी कार्रवाई से आने की अपेक्षा करें।

segments.src: The most reliable way to follow the story is to track specific bills, committee actions and official deadlines as they happen.
segments.tr: कहानी का पालन करने का सबसे विश्वसनीय तरीका विशिष्ट विधेयकों, समिति के कार्यों और आधिकारिक समय सीमा को ट्रैक करना है जैसे वे होते हैं।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute legal, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और इसमें कानूनी, कर या वित्तीय सलाह शामिल नहीं है।*

es.title: Tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato: qué significa el nuevo equilibrio de poder para los impuestos, el gasto y el comercio

segments.src: With the votes counted, the conversation in Washington shifts from campaigning to governing.
segments.tr: Con los votos ya contabilizados, la conversación en Washington pasa de las campañas a la labor de gobierno.

segments.src: Elections decide who holds the gavels, but the harder question is what the new Congress can actually pass, and what the president can do without it.

segments.src: ## Why the Balance of Power Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa el equilibrio de poder

segments.src: Most major economic policy in the United States requires agreement among three parties: the House, the Senate and the White House.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las grandes políticas económicas en los Estados Unidos requieren el acuerdo de tres partes: la Cámara de Representantes, el Senado y la Casa Blanca.

segments.src: When one party controls all three, legislation can move relatively quickly, though narrow margins still give small groups of lawmakers real leverage.
segments.tr: Cuando un partido controla las tres instancias, la legislación puede avanzar con relativa rapidez, aunque los márgenes estrechos siguen otorgando una influencia real a pequeños grupos de legisladores.

segments.src: When control is split, the typical result is negotiation, delay or gridlock, and a greater reliance on executive action and must-pass deadlines.
segments.tr: Cuando el control está dividido, el resultado habitual es la negociación, la demora o el bloqueo político, así como una mayor dependencia de las acciones ejecutivas y de los plazos de aprobación obligatoria.

segments.src: Three details often matter more than the headline result:
segments.tr: Tres detalles suelen importar más que el titular principal de los resultados:

segments.src: - **The size of the margin.** A majority of a few seats is hard to manage, because a handful of absences or defections can sink a bill.
segments.tr: - **El tamaño del margen.** Una mayoría de unos pocos escaños es difícil de gestionar, porque un puñado de ausencias o deserciones puede hundir un proyecto de ley.

segments.src: - **The Senate filibuster.** Most legislation needs 60 votes to advance in the Senate, which forces bipartisan deals unless a bill qualifies for a special process.
segments.tr: - **El filibusterismo del Senado.** La mayoría de los proyectos de ley necesitan 60 votos para avanzar en el Senado, lo que fuerza acuerdos bipartidistas a menos que un proyecto califique para un proceso especial.

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Whoever chairs the Ways and Means, Finance, Appropriations and Budget committees helps set the agenda, schedule hearings and shape the text of bills.
segments.tr: - **El liderazgo de los comités.** Quien presida los comités de Medios y Arbitrios, Finanzas, Presupuesto y Asignaciones ayuda a fijar la agenda, programar audiencias y dar forma al texto de las leyes.

segments.src: ## The Budget and Government Funding
segments.tr: ## El presupuesto y la financiación del gobierno

segments.src: Congress must pass appropriations bills each year to fund federal agencies.
segments.tr: El Congreso debe aprobar proyectos de ley de asignaciones cada año para financiar los organismos federales.

segments.src: When it fails to do so by the start of the fiscal year on October 1, it typically passes a short-term "continuing resolution" to keep the government open, or risks a partial shutdown.
segments.tr: Cuando no lo logra antes del inicio del año fiscal el 1 de octubre, suele aprobar una "resolución de continuidad" a corto plazo para mantener abierto el gobierno, o de lo contrario se arriesga a un cierre parcial.

segments.src: ### What to watch
segments.tr: ### Qué vigilar

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Negociaciones de asignaciones.** La Cámara de Representantes y el Senado deben ponerse de acuerdo sobre los niveles de gasto para programas de defensa y no relacionados con la defensa. Un Congreso dividido a menudo se traduce en medidas provisionales y grandes paquetes combinados al borde de los plazos límite.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **El límite de la deuda.** Periódicamente, el Congreso debe elevar o suspender el tope de endeudamiento para que el Tesoro pueda pagar las obligaciones ya contraídas. Estas votaciones se han convertido en repetidas ocasiones en ocasiones para negociaciones presupuestarias más amplias.

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **Programas de bienestar e interés de la deuda.** Social Security, Medicare y Medicaid representan una gran proporción del gasto federal, y los costes de interés de la deuda nacional han crecido. Las propuestas para modificar estos programas son políticamente difíciles y rara vez prosperan sin un amplio acuerdo.

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **Reconciliación presupuestaria.** Este procedimiento permite al Senado aprobar ciertas medidas fiscales y de gasto por mayoría simple, evitando el filibusterismo. Incluye reglas estrictas sobre lo que se puede incluir y solo se puede utilizar un número limitado de veces al año sobre un tema determinado.

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## Política fiscal

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: Los debates fiscales en los próximos dos años vendrán determinados por qué disposiciones están programadas para cambiar y cuánto desean modificarlas los legisladores.

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: La legislación fiscal incluye muchas disposiciones temporales que expiran en fechas fijas, lo que crea puntos de decisión naturales para el Congreso.

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### Preguntas clave

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **Prórrogas y vencimientos.** Cada vez que un conjunto de disposiciones fiscales está a punto de vencer, los legisladores deben decidir si prorrogarlas, modificarlas o dejarlas expirar. Cada elección afecta a los ingresos netos de los hogares y a la planificación empresarial.

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **Coste y compensaciones.** Los recortes de impuestos reducen los ingresos federales a menos que se compensen con reducciones de gasto u otros ingresos. Los evaluadores del Congreso, incluida la independiente Congressional Budget Office y el Joint Committee on Taxation, estiman estos costes, y sus cifras a menudo moldean el debate.

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **Deducciones y créditos específicos.** Las propuestas bipartidistas más pequeñas, como los cambios en los créditos por hijos, la amortización empresarial o los incentivos energéticos, tienen más probabilidades de aprobarse en un Congreso muy dividido que reformas integrales.

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **Límites del proceso.** Un proyecto de ley fiscal de gran calado sin apoyo bipartidista depende generalmente de la reconciliación, lo que limita lo que se puede incluir.

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: Para las familias y las pequeñas empresas, el consejo práctico es seguir la legislación promulgada de forma efectiva en lugar de las propuestas.

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las ideas debatidas durante una campaña nunca llegan a convertirse en ley en su forma original.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## Aranceles y comercio

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: La política comercial es inusual porque el poder ejecutivo ostenta una autoridad significativa.

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: El Congreso posee poder constitucional sobre los aranceles y el comercio exterior, pero ha delegado una gran parte de esa potestad en el presidente a través de varias leyes.

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: Como resultado, la política arancelaria puede cambiar más rápido que la política fiscal o de gasto.

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### Cómo puede seguir influyendo el Congreso en el comercio

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Supervisión.** Los comités pueden celebrar audiencias, solicitar documentos e interrogar a los funcionarios sobre los costes y efectos de los aranceles.

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **Legislación.** Los legisladores pueden proponer proyectos de ley para limitar, condicionar o codificar acciones comerciales, aunque tales medidas se enfrentan a un posible veto presidencial, el cual requiere un voto de dos tercios en ambas cámaras para ser anulado.

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **Acuerdos comerciales.** El Congreso desempeña un papel en la aprobación o aplicación de ciertos acuerdos comerciales y en la financiación de los organismos que velan por el cumplimiento de las normas comerciales.

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **Tribunales.** Los desafíos legales sobre el alcance de la autoridad arancelaria ejecutiva también pueden dar forma a los resultados, independientemente de cualquier votación en el Congreso.

segments.src: Tariffs are paid at the border by importers, and the costs can be passed along to businesses and consumers in different ways.
segments.tr: Los aranceles son pagados en la frontera por los importadores, y los costes se pueden repercutir a las empresas y consumidores de diferentes maneras.

segments.src: Economists generally disagree about how large the effects are and who bears them, which is one reason trade debates remain heated.
segments.tr: Los economistas en general no se ponen de acuerdo sobre la magnitud de los efectos y quién los asume, lo cual es una razón por la que los debates comerciales siguen siendo intensos.

segments.src: ## How the Scenarios Differ
segments.tr: ## Cómo se diferencian los escenarios

segments.src: | Scenario | Likely dynamics |
segments.tr: | Escenario | Dinámicas probables |

segments.src: | One party controls both chambers and the White House | Faster legislative action is possible, especially through reconciliation, but narrow margins can still stall bills |
segments.tr: | Un partido controla ambas cámaras y la Casa Blanca | Es posible una acción legislativa más rápida, especialmente a través de la reconciliación, pero los márgenes estrechos aún pueden estancar los proyectos de ley |

segments.src: | Split Congress | More negotiation, more stopgap measures, more oversight hearings, and fewer sweeping laws |
segments.tr: | Congreso dividido | Más negociación, más medidas provisionales, más audiencias de supervisión y menos leyes de gran alcance |

segments.src: | Divided government (White House and Congress controlled by different parties) | Greater use of the veto, executive action and confrontation over deadlines |
segments.tr: | Gobierno dividido (La Casa Blanca y el Congreso están controlados por partidos diferentes) | Mayor uso del veto, acciones ejecutivas y confrontación respecto a los plazos límites |

segments.src: ## Key Dates and Deadlines to Watch
segments.tr: ## Fechas clave y plazos a vigilar

segments.src: - **New Congress convenes in January**, when members are sworn in and leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: - **El nuevo Congreso se reúne en enero**, momento en que los miembros juran su cargo y se eligen a los líderes.

segments.src: - **Committee assignments and chairs** are set early in the session.
segments.tr: - **Las asignaciones de comités y las presidencias** se fijan al principio del período de sesiones.

segments.src: - **Funding deadlines** arrive on a recurring annual schedule.
segments.tr: - **Los plazos de financiación** llegan según un calendario anual recurrente.

segments.src: - **Expiring provisions** in tax and other laws create windows for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **Las disposiciones que vencen** en las leyes fiscales y de otro tipo abren ventanas para la negociación.

segments.src: - **The next election cycle** begins almost immediately and can affect how willing lawmakers are to compromise.
segments.tr: - **El siguiente ciclo electoral** comienza casi de inmediato y puede influir en la disposición de los legisladores a llegar a acuerdos.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Readers
segments.tr: ## Qué significa esto para los lectores

segments.src: - **Households:** Changes to taxes or benefits only matter once they are signed into law and take effect. Watch for effective dates and consult official guidance or a qualified tax professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: - **Hogares:** Los cambios en los impuestos o beneficios solo importan una vez que se firman como ley y entran en vigor. Preste atención a las fechas de entrada en vigor y consulte la orientación oficial o a un profesional fiscal cualificado antes de tomar decisiones financieras.

segments.src: - **Small businesses:** Tariff changes and tax provisions can affect costs and planning. Keep an eye on announcements from the relevant agencies.
segments.tr: - **Pequeñas empresas:** Los cambios arancelarios y las disposiciones fiscales pueden afectar a los costes y a la planificación. Manténgase al tanto de los anuncios de los organismos pertinentes.

segments.src: - **Investors and savers:** Political events can move markets in the short term, but long-term outcomes depend on many factors. This article is not investment advice.
segments.tr: - **Inversores y ahorradores:** Los acontecimientos políticos pueden mover los mercados a corto plazo, pero los resultados a largo plazo dependen de muchos factores. Este artículo no constituye un asesoramiento de inversión.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The election determines who sits at the table, but the rules of the Senate, the size of the margins and the calendar of deadlines determine what can actually get done.
segments.tr: Las elecciones determinan quién se sienta a la mesa, pero las reglas del Senado, el tamaño de los márgenes y el calendario de plazos determinan lo que realmente se puede llevar a cabo.

segments.src: Expect big promises to be narrowed by procedure, and expect some of the most consequential decisions, particularly on trade, to come from executive action as much as from legislation.
segments.tr: Es de esperar que las grandes promesas se reduzcan por el procedimiento, y que algunas de las decisiones más trascendentales, especialmente en materia de comercio, procedan tanto de acciones ejecutivas como de la legislación.

segments.src: The most reliable way to follow the story is to track specific bills, committee actions and official deadlines as they happen.
segments.tr: La forma más fiable de seguir la actualidad es hacer un seguimiento de los proyectos de ley específicos, las acciones de los comités y los plazos oficiales a medida que se producen.

segments.src: ## Tax Policy

segments.tr: ستتشكل المناقشات الضريبية على مدى العامين المقبلين بناءً على الأحكام المقرر تغييرها ومدى رغبة المشرعين في تعديلها.

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: يتضمن قانون الضرائب العديد من الأحكام المؤقتة التي تنتهي في تواريخ محددة، مما يخلق نقاط قرار طبيعية للكونغرس.

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### الأسئلة الرئيسية

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **التمديدات وانتهاء الصلاحية.** كلما اقترب تاريخ انتهاء مجموعة من الأحكام الضريبية، يجب على المشرعين التقرير بشأن تمديدها أو تعديلها أو تركها تنتهي. كل خيار يؤثر على الأجر الصافي للأسر والتخطيط للأعمال.

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **التكلفة والتعويضات.** تقلل التخفيضات الضريبية من الإيرادات الفيدرالية ما لم يتم تعويضها بتقليص الإنفاق أو إيرادات أخرى. يقدر مسؤولو التقييم في الكونغرس، بما في ذلك مكتب الميزانية التابع للكونغرس المستقل واللجنة المشتركة للضرائب، هذه التكاليف، وغالباً ما تشكل أرقامهم النقاش.

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **الائتمانات والخصومات الموجهة.** المقترحات الأصغر والأكثر توافقاً بين الحزبين، مثل التغييرات في الائتمانات المتعلقة بالأطفال، أو المصروفات التجارية، أو حوافز الطاقة، هي أكثر عرضة للإقرار في كونغرس منقسم بضيق مقارنة بالإصلاحات الشاملة.

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **حدود العملية.** يعتمد مشروع قانون ضريبي كبير دون دعم من الحزبين عموماً على التوافق والتسوية، مما يضيق نطاق ما يمكن تضمينه.

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأسر والأعمال التجارية الصغيرة، النصيحة العملية هي متابعة التشريعات الصادرة بالفعل بدلاً من المقترحات.

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: معظم الأفكار التي تمت مناقشتها خلال الحملة الانتخابية لا تصبح قانوناً بصيغتها الأصلية أبداً.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## التعريفات الجمركية والتجارة

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: تعتبر السياسة التجارية غير عادية لأن السلطة التنفيذية تمتلك صلاحيات كبيرة فيها.

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: يمتلك الكونغرس سلطة دستورية على التعريفات الجمركية والتجارة الخارجية، ولكنه فوض قدرًا كبيرًا من هذه السلطة للرئيس من خلال عدة قوانين.

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: ونتيجة لذلك، يمكن لسياسة التعريفات الجمركية أن تتغير بسرعة أكبر من سياسة الضرائب أو الإنفاق.

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### كيف يمكن للكونغرس الاستمرار في التأثير على التجارة

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **الرقابة.** يمكن للجان عقد جلسات استماع، وطلب المستندات، واستجواب المسؤولين حول تكاليف وتأثيرات التعريفات الجمركية.

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **التشريع.** يمكن للمشرعين اقتراح مشاريع قوانين للحد من الإجراءات التجارية أو تقييدها أو تدوينها، على الرغم من أن هذه التدابير تواجه فيتو رئاسياً محتملاً، والذي يتطلب أغلبيتي الثلثين في كلا المجلسين لتجاوزه.

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **الاتفاقيات التجارية.** للكونغرس دور في الموافقة على بعض الصفقات التجارية أو تنفيذها وفي تمويل الوكالات التي تطبق قواعد التجارة.

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **المحاكم.** يمكن للطعون القانونية بشأن نطاق السلطة التنفيذية في فرض التعريفات أن تشكل أيضاً المخرجات، بشكل مستقل عن أي تصويت في الكونغرس.

segments.src: Tariffs are paid at the border by importers, and the costs can be passed along to businesses and consumers in different ways.
segments.tr: يتم دفع التعريفات الجمركية عند الحدود من قبل المستوردين، ويمكن تمرير التكاليف إلى الشركات المستهلكة والمستهلكين بطرق مختلفة.

segments.src: Economists generally disagree about how large the effects are and who bears them, which is one reason trade debates remain heated.
segments.tr: يختلف الاقتصاديون عموماً حول مدى كبر التأثيرات ومن يتحملها، وهو أحد الأسباب التي تجعل المناقشات التجارية تظل محتدمة.

segments.src: ## How the Scenarios Differ
segments.tr: ## كيف تختلف السيناريوهات

segments.src: | Scenario | Likely dynamics |
segments.tr: | السيناريو | الديناميكيات المحتملة |

segments.src: | One party controls both chambers and the White House | Faster legislative action is possible, especially through reconciliation, but narrow margins can still stall bills |
segments.tr: | حزب واحد يسيطر على كلا المجلسين والبيت الأبيض | العمل التشريعي الأسرع ممكن، لا سيما من خلال المصالحة، ولكن الهوامش الضيقة لا تزال تعرقل مشاريع القوانين |

segments.src: | Split Congress | More negotiation, more stopgap measures, more oversight hearings, and fewer sweeping laws |
segments.tr: | كونغرس مقسم | المزيد من المفاوضات، والمزيد من التدابير المؤقتة، والمزيد من جلسات الاستماع الرقابية، وقوانين أقل شمولاً |

segments.src: | Divided government (White House and Congress controlled by different parties) | Greater use of the veto, executive action and confrontation over deadlines |
segments.tr: | حكومة مقسمة (البيت الأبيض والكونغرس تحت سيطرة أحزاب مختلفة) | استخدام أكبر للفيتو، والإجراءات التنفيذية والمواجهة حول المواعيد النهائية |

segments.src: ## Key Dates and Deadlines to Watch
segments.tr: ## التواريخ والمواعيد النهائية الرئيسية للمتابعة

segments.src: - **New Congress convenes in January**, when members are sworn in and leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: - **ينعقد الكونغرس الجديد في يناير**، حيث يؤدي الأعضاء اليمين ويتم اختيار القادة.

segments.src: - **Committee assignments and chairs** are set early in the session.
segments.tr: - **تعيينات اللجان ورؤساؤها** تتحدد في وقت مبكر من الدورة.

segments.src: - **Funding deadlines** arrive on a recurring annual schedule.
segments.tr: - **المواعيد النهائية للتمويل** تصل وفق جدول سنوي متكرر.

segments.src: - **Expiring provisions** in tax and other laws create windows for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **الأحكام التي تنتهي صلاحيتها** في الضرائب والقوانين الأخرى تخلق فرصاً للمفاوضات.

segments.src: - **The next election cycle** begins almost immediately and can affect how willing lawmakers are to compromise.
segments.tr: - **الدورة الانتخابية القادمة** تبدأ فوراً تقريباً ويمكن أن تؤثر على مدى استعداد المشرعين للتسوية.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Readers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا بالنسبة للقراء

segments.src: - **Households:** Changes to taxes or benefits only matter once they are signed into law and take effect. Watch for effective dates and consult official guidance or a qualified tax professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: - **الأسر:** التغييرات في الضرائب أو الفوائد تهم فقط بمجرد توقيعها لتحتسب كقانون وتدخل حيز التنفيذ. راقب تواريخ البدء واستشر التوجيهات الرسمية أو مستشاراً ضريبياً مؤهلاً قبل اتخاذ قرارات مالية.

segments.src: - **Small businesses:** Tariff changes and tax provisions can affect costs and planning. Keep an eye on announcements from the relevant agencies.
segments.tr: - **الأعمال التجارية الصغيرة:** تغييرات التعريفات الجمركية والأحكام الضريبية يمكن أن تؤثر على التكاليف والتخطيط. ابقَ على اطلاع بإعلانات الوكالات المعنية.

segments.src: - **Investors and savers:** Political events can move markets in the short term, but long-term outcomes depend on many factors. This article is not investment advice.
segments.tr: - **المستثمرون والمستثمرون للادخار:** الأحداث السياسية يمكن أن تحرك الأسواق على المدى القصير، لكن النتائج طويلة الأجل تتبع عوامل عديدة. هذا المقال ليس نصيحة استثمارية.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The election determines who sits at the table, but the rules of the Senate, the size of the margins and the calendar of deadlines determine what can actually get done.
segments.tr: تحدد الانتخابات من يجلس على الطاولة، لكن قواعد مجلس الشيوخ، وحجم الهوامش، وجدول المواعيد النهائية هي التي تحدد ما يمكن إنجازه بالفعل.

segments.src: Expect big promises to be narrowed by procedure, and expect some of the most consequential decisions, particularly on trade, to come from executive action as much as from legislation.
segments.tr: توقع أن يتم تضييق الوعود الكبيرة عن طريق الإجراءات، وتوقع أن تأتي بعض أكثر القرارات حسمًا، وخاصة بشأن التجارة، من الإجراءات التنفيذية بقدر ما تأتي من التشريعات.

segments.src: The most reliable way to follow the story is to track specific bills, committee actions and official deadlines as they happen.
segments.tr: الطريقة الأكثر موثوقية لمتابعة القصة هي تتبع مشاريع القوانين المحددة، وإجراءات اللجان، والمواعيد النهائية الرسمية فور حدوثها.
