fr.title: Après les élections de mi-mandat : ce que le nouvel équilibre des pouvoirs implique pour les impôts, les dépenses et le commerce

segments.src: With the votes counted, the conversation in Washington shifts from campaigning to governing.
segments.tr: Une fois les votes comptés, la discussion à Washington passe de la campagne électorale à la gouvernance.

segments.src: Elections decide who holds the gavels, but the harder question is what the new Congress can actually pass, and what the president can do without it.
segments.tr: Les élections décident de qui détient le marteau de président d'assemblée, mais la question la plus difficile est de savoir ce que le nouveau Congrès peut réellement adopter, et ce que le président peut faire sans lui.

segments.src: This explainer walks through the main levers on the budget, tax policy and tariffs, and why the final shape of the new Congress matters so much for the next two years.
segments.tr: Cet article explicatif passe en revue les principaux leviers sur le budget, la politique fiscale et les tarifs douaniers, et explique pourquoi la composition finale du nouveau Congrès compte tant pour les deux prochaines années.

segments.src: *Note: Final margins, especially in closely divided chambers, can take time to settle.
segments.tr: *Remarque : Les écarts finaux, en particulier dans les chambres très serrées, peuvent prendre du temps à se stabiliser.

segments.src: This article focuses on how the process works rather than on predictions, and readers should check official results for the latest seat counts.*
segments.tr: Cet article se concentre sur le fonctionnement du processus plutôt que sur des prédictions, et les lecteurs sont invités à consulter les résultats officiels pour connaître les derniers décomptes de sièges.*

segments.src: ## Why the Balance of Power Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'équilibre des pouvoirs est important

segments.src: Most major economic policy in the United States requires agreement among three parties: the House, the Senate and the White House.
segments.tr: La plupart des grandes politiques économiques aux États-Unis nécessitent l'accord de trois parties : la Chambre des représentants, le Sénat et la Maison-Blanche.

segments.src: When one party controls all three, legislation can move relatively quickly, though narrow margins still give small groups of lawmakers real leverage.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'un seul parti contrôle les trois, la législation peut avancer relativement vite, bien que de faibles majorités donnent encore un véritable moyen de pression à de petits groupes de parlementaires.

segments.src: When control is split, the typical result is negotiation, delay or gridlock, and a greater reliance on executive action and must-pass deadlines.
segments.tr: Lorsque le contrôle est partagé, le résultat habituel est la négociation, le retard ou l'impasse, ainsi qu'un recours accru aux actions exécutives et aux échéances incontournables.

segments.src: Three details often matter more than the headline result:
segments.tr: Trois détails comptent souvent plus que le résultat principal :

segments.src: - **The size of the margin.** A majority of a few seats is hard to manage, because a handful of absences or defections can sink a bill.
segments.tr: - **La taille de la marge.** Une majorité de quelques sièges est difficile à gérer, car une poignée d'absences ou de défections peut faire couler un projet de loi.

segments.src: - **The Senate filibuster.** Most legislation needs 60 votes to advance in the Senate, which forces bipartisan deals unless a bill qualifies for a special process.
segments.tr: - **Le filibuster au Sénat.** La plupart des textes législatifs nécessitent 60 voix pour avancer au Sénat, ce qui impose des accords bipartites à moins qu'un projet de loi n'entre dans le cadre d'une procédure spéciale.

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Whoever chairs the Ways and Means, Finance, Appropriations and Budget committees helps set the agenda, schedule hearings and shape the text of bills.
segments.tr: - **La présidence des commissions.** Quiconque préside les commissions des voies et moyens (Ways and Means), des finances, des appropriations et du budget aide à fixer l'ordre du jour, à programmer les auditions et meuler le texte des projets de loi.

segments.src: ## The Budget and Government Funding
segments.tr: ## Le budget et le financement du gouvernement

segments.src: Congress must pass appropriations bills each year to fund federal agencies.
segments.tr: Le Congrès doit adopter des lois de finances (appropriations) chaque année pour financer les agences fédérales.

segments.src: When it fails to do so by the start of the fiscal year on October 1, it typically passes a short-term "continuing resolution" to keep the government open, or risks a partial shutdown.
segments.tr: S'il n'y parvient pas avant le début de l'année fiscale, le 1er octobre, il adopte généralement une "résolution continue" à court terme pour maintenir les services publics ouverts, sous peine de risquer une fermeture partielle (shutdown).

segments.src: ### What to watch
segments.tr: ### Ce qu'il faut surveiller

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Les négociations budgétaires.** La Chambre et le Sénat doivent s'entendre sur les niveaux de dépenses pour les programmes de défense et hors défense. Un Congrès divisé signifie souvent des mesures provisoires et de grands paquets combinés à l'approche des échéances.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **Le plafond de la dette.** Périodiquement, le Congrès doit relever ou suspendre le plafond d'emprunt afin que le Trésor puisse honorer les engagements déjà pris. Ces votes sont à plusieurs reprises devenus l'occasion de négociations budgétaires plus larges.

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **Les programmes sociaux et les déficits.** La Sécurité sociale, Medicare et Medicaid représentent une grande part des dépenses fédérales, et la charge d'intérêts sur la dette nationale a augmenté. Les propositions visant à modifier ces programmes sont politiquement difficiles et aboutissent rarement sans un large accord.

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **La réconciliation budgétaire.** Cette procédure permet au Sénat d'adopter certaines mesures fiscales et budgétaires à la majorité simple, évitant ainsi le filibuster. Elle s'accompagne de règles strictes sur ce qui peut y être inclus et ne peut être utilisée qu'un nombre limité de fois sur un sujet donné chaque année.

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## La politique fiscale

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: Les débats fiscaux des deux prochaines années seront façonnés par les dispositions dont le changement est programmé et par la mesure dans laquelle les législateurs souhaitent les modifier.

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: La loi fiscale comprend de nombreuses dispositions temporaires qui expirent à des dates fixes, ce qui crée des moments de décision naturels pour le Congrès.

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### Questions clés

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **Prolongations et expirations.** Chaque fois qu'un ensemble de dispositions fiscales arrive à échéance, les législateurs doivent décider de les prolonger, de les modifier ou de les laisser expirer. Chaque choix a une incidence sur le revenu disponible des ménages et la planification des entreprises.

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **Coûts et compensations.** Les réductions d'impôts diminuent les recettes fédérales à moins d'être compensées par des réductions de dépenses ou d'autres recettes. Les évaluateurs du Congrès, notamment le Congressional Budget Office (non partisan) et le Joint Committee on Taxation, estiment ces coûts, et leurs chiffres orientent souvent le débat.

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **Crédits et déductions ciblés.** Des propositions bipartites plus modestes, comme des modifications aux crédits liés aux enfants, à l'amortissement des entreprises ou aux incitations énergétiques, ont plus de chances de passer dans un Congrès étroitement divisé que de vastes réformes.

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **Limites procédurales.** Un projet de loi fiscal majeur sans soutien bipartite dépend généralement de la réconciliation, ce qui restreint ce qui peut y être inclus.

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages et les petites entreprises, le conseil pratique est de suivre la législation réellement promulguée plutôt que les propositions.

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: La plupart des idées débattues lors d'une campagne ne deviennent jamais des lois sous leur forme d'origine.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## Tarifs douaniers et commerce

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: La politique commerciale est particulière car le pouvoir exécutif détient une autorité significative.

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: Le Congrès a le pouvoir constitutionnel sur les tarifs douaniers et le commerce extérieur, mais il a délégué une grande partie de ce pouvoir au président par le biais de plusieurs lois.

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: En conséquence, la politique tarifaire peut évoluer plus rapidement que la politique fiscale ou budgétaire.

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### Comment le Congrès peut encore influencer le commerce

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Surveillance.** Les commissions peuvent organiser des auditions, demander des documents et interroger des responsables sur les coûts et les effets des tarifs douaniers.

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **Législation.** Les législateurs peuvent proposer des projets de loi pour limiter, conditionner ou codifier les actions commerciales, bien que de telles mesures risquent un veto présidentiel, qui nécessite une majorité des deux tiers dans les deux chambres pour être surmonté.

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **Accords commerciaux.** Le Congrès joue un rôle dans l'approbation ou la mise en œuvre de certains accords commerciaux et dans le financement des agences qui font appliquer les règles commerciales.

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **Tribunaux.** Les contestations juridiques concernant l'étendue de l'autorité tarifaire de l'exécutif peuvent également influencer les résultats, indépendamment de tout vote au Congrès.

segments.src: Tariffs are paid at the border by importers, and the costs can be passed along to businesses and consumers in different ways.
segments.tr: Les tarifs douaniers sont payés à la frontière par les importateurs, et les coûts peuvent être répercutés de différentes manières sur les entreprises et les consommateurs.

segments.src: Economists generally disagree about how large the effects are and who bears them, which is one reason trade debates remain heated.

pt.title: Após as eleições de meio de mandato: O que o novo equilíbrio de poder significa para impostos, gastos e comércio

segments.src: With the votes counted, the conversation in Washington shifts from campaigning to governing.
segments.tr: Com a contagem dos votos concluída, a conversa em Washington muda de campanha para governança.

segments.src: Elections decide who holds the gavels, but the harder question is what the new Congress can actually pass, and what the president can do without it.
segments.tr: As eleições decidem quem detém o poder, mas a questão mais difícil é o que o novo Congresso pode realmente aprovar e o que o presidente pode fazer sem ele.

segments.src: This explainer walks through the main levers on the budget, tax policy and tariffs, and why the final shape of the new Congress matters so much for the next two years.
segments.tr: Este explicativo percorre as principais alavancas sobre o orçamento, política tributária e tarifas, e por que a forma final do novo Congresso é tão importante para os próximos dois anos.

segments.src: *Note: Final margins, especially in closely divided chambers, can take time to settle.
segments.tr: *Nota: As margens finais, especialmente em câmaras divididas, podem levar tempo para serem definidas.

segments.tr: Este artigo foca em como o processo funciona, em vez de previsões, e os leitores devem verificar os resultados oficiais para as contagens de assentos mais recentes.*

segments.src: ## Why the Balance of Power Matters
segments.tr: ## Por que o equilíbrio de poder é importante

segments.src: Most major economic policy in the United States requires agreement among three parties: the House, the Senate and the White House.
segments.tr: A maior parte da política econômica importante nos Estados Unidos exige acordo entre três partes: a Câmara, o Senado e a Casa Branca.

segments.src: When one party controls all three, legislation can move relatively quickly, though narrow margins still give small groups of lawmakers real leverage.
segments.tr: Quando um partido controla os três, a legislação pode avançar relativamente rápido, embora margens estreitas ainda deem a pequenos grupos de legisladores uma influência real.

segments.src: When control is split, the typical result is negotiation, delay or gridlock, and a greater reliance on executive action and must-pass deadlines.
segments.tr: Quando o controle é dividido, o resultado típico é negociação, atraso ou impasse, e uma maior dependência de ações executivas e prazos obrigatórios.

segments.src: Three details often matter more than the headline result:
segments.tr: Três detalhes muitas vezes importam mais do que o resultado principal:

segments.src: - **The size of the margin.** A majority of a few seats is hard to manage, because a handful of absences or defections can sink a bill.
segments.tr: - **O tamanho da margem.** Uma maioria de poucos assentos é difícil de gerenciar, porque um punhado de ausências ou deserções pode derrubar um projeto de lei.

segments.src: - **The Senate filibuster.** Most legislation needs 60 votes to advance in the Senate, which forces bipartisan deals unless a bill qualifies for a special process.
segments.tr: - **A obstrução no Senado (filibuster).** A maioria da legislação precisa de 60 votos para avançar no Senado, o que força acordos bipartidários, a menos que um projeto de lei se qualifique para um processo especial.

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Whoever chairs the Ways and Means, Finance, Appropriations and Budget committees helps set the agenda, schedule hearings and shape the text of bills.
segments.tr: - **Liderança de comitês.** Quem preside os comitês de Meios e Recursos (Ways and Means), Finanças, Apropriações e Orçamento ajuda a definir a agenda, agendar audiências e moldar o texto dos projetos de lei.

segments.src: ## The Budget and Government Funding
segments.tr: ## O orçamento e o financiamento do governo

segments.src: Congress must pass appropriations bills each year to fund federal agencies.
segments.tr: O Congresso deve aprovar projetos de lei de apropriações a cada ano para financiar agências federais.

segments.src: When it fails to do so by the start of the fiscal year on October 1, it typically passes a short-term "continuing resolution" to keep the government open, or risks a partial shutdown.
segments.tr: Quando não o faz até o início do ano fiscal em 1º de outubro, normalmente aprova uma "resolução contínua" de curto prazo para manter o governo aberto, ou arrisca uma paralisação parcial.

segments.src: ### What to watch
segments.tr: ### O que observar

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Negociações de apropriações.** A Câmara e o Senado devem concordar sobre os níveis de gastos para programas de defesa e não relacionados à defesa. Um Congresso dividido geralmente significa medidas provisórias e grandes pacotes combinados perto dos prazos.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **O limite da dívida.** Periodicamente, o Congresso deve aumentar ou suspender o teto de endividamento para que o Tesouro possa pagar as obrigações já contraídas. Essas votações tornaram-se repetidamente ocasiões para negociações orçamentárias mais amplas.

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **Benefícios e déficits.** Previdência Social, Medicare e Medicaid compõem uma grande parte dos gastos federais, e os custos de juros sobre a dívida nacional cresceram. Propostas para alterar esses programas são politicamente difíceis e raramente avançam sem um amplo acordo.

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **Conciliação orçamentária.** Este procedimento permite que o Senado aprove certas medidas fiscais e de gastos com uma maioria simples, evitando a obstrução. Ele vem com regras rígidas sobre o que pode ser incluído e só pode ser usado um número limitado de vezes em um determinado tópico a cada ano.

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## Política tributária

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: Os debates fiscais nos próximos dois anos serão moldados por quais disposições estão programadas para mudar e quanto os legisladores querem alterá-las.

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: A lei tributária inclui muitas disposições temporárias que expiram em datas definidas, o que cria pontos de decisão naturais para o Congresso.

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### Questões-chave

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **Extensões e expirações.** Sempre que um conjunto de disposições fiscais está prestes a expirar, os legisladores devem decidir se devem estender, modificar ou deixá-las caducar. Cada escolha afeta a renda disponível das famílias e o planejamento das empresas.

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **Custo e compensações.** Cortes de impostos reduzem a receita federal, a menos que sejam compensados por reduções de gastos ou outras receitas. Os responsáveis pela pontuação do Congresso, incluindo o Escritório de Orçamento do Congresso apartidário e o Comitê Conjunto de Tributação, estimam esses custos, e seus números muitas vezes moldam o debate.

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **Créditos e deduções direcionados.** Propostas menores e bipartidárias, como mudanças em créditos relacionados a crianças, despesas comerciais ou incentivos energéticos, são mais propensas a passar em um Congresso estreitamente dividido do que reformas abrangentes.

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **Limites de processo.** Um grande projeto de lei tributária sem apoio bipartidário geralmente depende da conciliação, o que restringe o que pode ser incluído.

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: Para famílias e pequenas empresas, o conselho prático é seguir a legislação efetivamente promulgada, em vez de propostas.

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: A maioria das ideias discutidas durante uma campanha nunca se torna lei em sua forma original.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## Tarifas e comércio

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: A política comercial é incomum porque o poder executivo detém autoridade significativa.

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: O Congresso tem poder constitucional sobre tarifas e comércio exterior, mas delegou grande parte desse poder ao presidente por meio de vários estatutos.

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: Como resultado, a política tarifária pode mudar mais rapidamente do que a política fiscal ou de gastos.

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### Como o Congresso ainda pode influenciar o comércio

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Fiscalização.** Os comitês podem realizar audiências, solicitar documentos e questionar autoridades sobre os custos e efeitos das tarifas.

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **Legislação.** Os legisladores podem propor projetos de lei para limitar, condicionar ou codificar ações comerciais, embora tais medidas enfrentem um possível veto presidencial, que exige uma votação de dois terços em ambas as câmaras para ser derrubado.

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **Acordos comerciais.** O Congresso tem um papel na aprovação ou implementação de certos acordos comerciais e no financiamento das agências que aplicam as regras comerciais.

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **Tribunais.** Desafios legais sobre o escopo da autoridade tarifária executiva também podem moldar os resultados, independentemente de qualquer votação no Congresso.

segments.src: Tariffs are paid at the border by importers, and the costs can be passed along to businesses and consumers in different ways.
segments.tr: As tarifas são pagas na fronteira pelos importadores, e os custos podem ser repassados às empresas e aos consumidores de diferentes maneiras.

segments.src: Economists generally disagree about how large the effects are and who bears them, which is one reason trade debates remain heated.
segments.tr: Os economistas geralmente discordam sobre quão grandes são os efeitos e quem os suporta, o que é uma das razões pelas quais os debates comerciais permanecem acalorados.

segments.tr: ## Como os cenários diferem

segments.tr: | Cenário | Dinâmicas prováveis |

segments.tr: | Congresso dividido | Mais negociação, mais medidas provisórias, mais audiências de fiscalização e menos leis abrangentes |

segments.tr: | Governo dividido (Casa Branca e Congresso controlados por partidos diferentes) | Maior uso do veto, ação executiva e confronto sobre prazos |

segments.tr: ## Datas e prazos importantes para observar

segments.tr: - **Os prazos de financiamento** chegam em um cronograma anual recorrente.

segments.tr: ### Hal yang perlu diperhatikan

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Negosiasi alokasi anggaran.** DPR dan Senat harus menyepakati tingkat pengeluaran untuk program pertahanan dan non-pertahanan. Kongres yang terbagi sering kali berarti adanya tindakan sementara dan paket gabungan besar mendekati tenggat waktu.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **Batas utang.** Secara berkala, Kongres harus menaikkan atau menangguhkan batas pinjaman agar Departemen Keuangan dapat membayar kewajiban yang sudah terjadi. Pemungutan suara ini berulang kali menjadi ajang tawar-menawar anggaran yang lebih luas.

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **Program jaminan sosial dan defisit.** Jaminan Sosial, Medicare, dan Medicaid menyumbang sebagian besar pengeluaran federal, dan biaya bunga atas utang nasional telah meningkat. Usulan untuk mengubah program-program ini sulit secara politik dan jarang berjalan tanpa kesepakatan luas.

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **Rekonsiliasi anggaran.** Prosedur ini memungkinkan Senat meloloskan tindakan pajak dan pengeluaran tertentu dengan mayoritas sederhana, menghindari filibuster. Aturan ini disertai ketentuan ketat tentang apa yang dapat dimasukkan, dan hanya dapat digunakan dalam jumlah terbatas untuk topik tertentu setiap tahunnya.

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## Kebijakan Pajak

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: Debat pajak selama dua tahun ke depan akan dibentuk oleh ketentuan mana yang dijadwalkan berubah dan seberapa banyak anggota dewan ingin mengubahnya.

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: Hukum pajak mencakup banyak ketentuan sementara yang berakhir pada tanggal yang ditetapkan, yang menciptakan titik keputusan alami bagi Kongres.

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### Pertanyaan kunci

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **Perpanjangan dan kedaluwarsa.** Setiap kali serangkaian ketentuan pajak akan berakhir, anggota dewan harus memutuskan apakah akan memperpanjang, mengubah, atau membiarkannya berakhir. Setiap pilihan memengaruhi pendapatan bersih rumah tangga dan perencanaan bisnis.

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **Biaya dan pengimbang.** Pemotongan pajak mengurangi pendapatan federal kecuali diimbangi dengan pengurangan pengeluaran atau pendapatan lain. Penilai skor Kongres, termasuk Congressional Budget Office yang independen dan Joint Committee on Taxation, mengestimasi biaya-biaya ini, dan angka-angka mereka sering kali membentuk perdebatan.

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **Kredit dan potongan yang terarah.** Proposal yang lebih kecil dan didukung dua partai, seperti perubahan pada kredit terkait anak, pembebanan biaya bisnis, atau insentif energi, lebih mungkin lolos di Kongres yang terbagi tipis daripada perombakan besar-besaran.

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **Batas proses.** RUU pajak utama tanpa dukungan dwipartai umumnya bergantung pada rekonsiliasi, yang membatasi apa saja yang dapat dimasukkan.

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: Bagi rumah tangga dan bisnis kecil, saran praktisnya adalah mengikuti undang-undang yang benar-benar telah diundangkan daripada sekadar proposal.

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar ide yang dibahas selama kampanye tidak pernah menjadi undang-undang dalam bentuk aslinya.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## Tarif dan Perdagangan

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: Kebijakan perdagangan terbilang tidak biasa karena cabang eksekutif memegang wewenang yang signifikan.

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: Kongres memiliki kekuasaan konstitusional atas tarif dan perdagangan luar negeri, tetapi telah melimpahkan banyak dari kekuasaan tersebut kepada presiden melalui beberapa undang-undang.

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: Akibatnya, kebijakan tarif dapat berubah lebih cepat daripada kebijakan pajak atau pengeluaran.

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### Bagaimana Kongres masih dapat memengaruhi perdagangan

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Pengawasan.** Komite dapat menggelar dengar pendapat, meminta dokumen, dan menginterogasi pejabat mengenai biaya dan dampak tarif.

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **Legislasi.** Anggota dewan dapat mengusulkan RUU untuk membatasi, mensyaratkan, atau mengodifikasikan tindakan perdagangan, meskipun tindakan tersebut menghadapi kemungkinan veto presiden, yang membutuhkan dua pertiga suara di kedua majelis untuk membatalkannya.

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **Perjanjian perdagangan.** Kongres berperan dalam menyetujui atau mengimplementasikan kesepakatan perdagangan tertentu dan dalam mendanai badan-badan yang menegakkan aturan perdagangan.

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **Pengadilan.** Tantangan hukum atas cakupan wewenang tarif eksekutif juga dapat membentuk hasil, independen dari pemungutan suara di Kongres.

segments.src: Tariffs are paid at the border by importers, and the costs can be passed along to businesses and consumers in different ways.
segments.tr: Tarif dibayar di perbatasan oleh importir, dan biayanya dapat diteruskan ke bisnis dan konsumen dengan cara yang berbeda-beda.

segments.src: Economists generally disagree about how large the effects are and who bears them, which is one reason trade debates remain heated.
segments.tr: Ekonom umumnya tidak sependapat tentang seberapa besar dampaknya dan siapa yang menanggungnya, yang menjadi salah satu alasan mengapa debat perdagangan tetap hangat.

segments.src: ## How the Scenarios Differ
segments.tr: ## Perbedaan Berbagai Skenario

segments.src: | Scenario | Likely dynamics |
segments.tr: | Skenario | Dinamika yang mungkin terjadi |

segments.src: | One party controls both chambers and the White House | Faster legislative action is possible, especially through reconciliation, but narrow margins can still stall bills |
segments.tr: | Satu partai mengendalikan kedua majelis dan Gedung Putih | Tindakan legislatif yang lebih cepat dimungkinkan, terutama melalui rekonsiliasi, tetapi marjin yang tipis tetap dapat menghambat RUU |

segments.src: | Split Congress | More negotiation, more stopgap measures, more oversight hearings, and fewer sweeping laws |
segments.tr: | Kongres terbagi | Lebih banyak negosiasi, lebih banyak tindakan sementara, lebih banyak dengar pendapat pengawasan, dan lebih sedikit undang-undang berskala besar |

segments.src: | Divided government (White House and Congress controlled by different parties) | Greater use of the veto, executive action and confrontation over deadlines |
segments.tr: | Pemerintahan terbagi (Gedung Putih dan Kongres dikendalikan oleh partai berbeda) | Penggunaan veto yang lebih besar, tindakan eksekutif, dan konfrontasi terkait tenggat waktu |

segments.src: ## Key Dates and Deadlines to Watch
segments.tr: ## Tanggal dan Tenggat Waktu Penting yang Perlu Diperhatikan

segments.src: - **New Congress convenes in January**, when members are sworn in and leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: - **Kongres baru berkumpul pada bulan Januari**, saat para anggota dilantik dan pemimpin dipilih.

segments.src: - **Committee assignments and chairs** are set early in the session.
segments.tr: - **Penugasan dan ketua komite** ditetapkan di awal sesi.

segments.src: - **Funding deadlines** arrive on a recurring annual schedule.
segments.tr: - **Tenggat waktu pendanaan** tiba dalam jadwal tahunan yang berulang.

segments.src: - **Expiring provisions** in tax and other laws create windows for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **Ketentuan yang akan berakhir** dalam hukum pajak dan undang-undang lainnya membuka ruang untuk negosiasi.

segments.src: - **The next election cycle** begins almost immediately and can affect how willing lawmakers are to compromise.
segments.tr: - **Siklus pemilu berikutnya** dimulai hampir segera dan dapat memengaruhi seberapa bersedia anggota dewan untuk berkompromi.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Readers
segments.tr: ## Arti Hal Ini bagi Pembaca

segments.src: - **Households:** Changes to taxes or benefits only matter once they are signed into law and take effect. Watch for effective dates and consult official guidance or a qualified tax professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: - **Rumah tangga:** Perubahan pada pajak atau tunjangan baru penting setelah ditandatangani menjadi undang-undang dan berlaku secara efektif. Perhatikan tanggal berlakunya dan konsultasikan panduan resmi atau profesional pajak yang berkualifikasi sebelum mengambil keputusan keuangan.

segments.src: - **Small businesses:** Tariff changes and tax provisions can affect costs and planning. Keep an eye on announcements from the relevant agencies.
segments.tr: - **Bisnis kecil:** Perubahan tarif dan ketentuan pajak dapat memengaruhi biaya dan perencanaan. Pantau pengumuman dari instansi-instansi terkait.

segments.src: - **Investors and savers:** Political events can move markets in the short term, but long-term outcomes depend on many factors. This article is not investment advice.
segments.tr: - **Investor dan penyimpan uang:** Peristiwa politik dapat menggerakkan pasar dalam jangka pendek, tetapi hasil jangka panjang bergantung pada banyak faktor. Artikel ini bukan merupakan nasihat investasi.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The election determines who sits at the table, but the rules of the Senate, the size of the margins and the calendar of deadlines determine what can actually get done.
segments.tr: Pemilu menentukan siapa yang duduk di meja perundingan, tetapi aturan Senat, besarnya marjin, dan kalender tenggat waktu menentukan apa yang sebenarnya dapat diselesaikan.

segments.src: Expect big promises to be narrowed by procedure, and expect some of the most consequential decisions, particularly on trade, to come from executive action as much as from legislation.
segments.tr: Perkirakan janji-janji besar akan dipersempit oleh prosedur, dan perkirakan beberapa keputusan paling berdampak, terutama mengenai perdagangan, akan berasal dari tindakan eksekutif sama halnya dari legislasi.

segments.src: The most reliable way to follow the story is to track specific bills, committee actions and official deadlines as they happen.
segments.tr: Cara paling andal untuk mengikuti perkembangan ini adalah dengan melacak RUU spesifik, tindakan komite, dan tenggat waktu resmi saat hal itu terjadi.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute legal, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat hukum, pajak, atau keuangan.*

ja.title: 中間選挙後：新しい勢力均衡が税金、支出、貿易に意味するもの

segments.src: With the votes counted, the conversation in Washington shifts from campaigning to governing.
segments.tr: 開票が終了し、ワシントンでの会話は選挙戦から政権運営へとシフトします。

segments.src: Elections decide who holds the gavels, but the harder question is what the new Congress can actually pass, and what the president can do without it.
segments.tr: 選挙は誰が槌（ gavel ）を握るかを決定しますが、より難しい問題は、新しい議会が実際に何を可決できるか、そして大統領が議会なしで何ができるかということです。

segments.src: This explainer walks through the main levers on the budget, tax policy and tariffs, and why the final shape of the new Congress matters so much for the next two years.
segments.tr: この解説記事では、予算、税制、関税に関する主な手段と、新議会の最終的な構成がなぜ今後の2年間にとってそれほど重要なのかを解説します。

segments.src: *Note: Final margins, especially in closely divided chambers, can take time to settle.
segments.tr: *注：特に僅差の議院では、最終的な議席差が確定するまでに時間がかかる場合があります。

segments.src: This article focuses on how the process works rather than on predictions, and readers should check official results for the latest seat counts.*
segments.tr: この記事は予測ではなくプロセスの仕組みに焦点を当てており、読者は最新の議席数について公式結果を確認する必要があります。*

segments.src: ## Why the Balance of Power Matters
segments.tr: ## なぜ勢力均衡が重要なのか

segments.src: Most major economic policy in the United States requires agreement among three parties: the House, the Senate and the White House.
segments.tr: 米国におけるほとんどの主要な経済政策は、下院、上院、ホワイトハウスの3者の合意を必要とします。

segments.src: When one party controls all three, legislation can move relatively quickly, though narrow margins still give small groups of lawmakers real leverage.
segments.tr: 単一の政党がこれら3つすべてを支配している場合、法案は比較的速やかに進行する可能性がありますが、僅差の場合は依然として少数派の議員グループが実質的な影響力を持ちます。

segments.src: When control is split, the typical result is negotiation, delay or gridlock, and a greater reliance on executive action and must-pass deadlines.
segments.tr: 勢力が分かれている場合、典型的な結果は交渉、遅延、または行詰まり（グリッドロック）であり、大統領令や不可避の期限への依存度が高まります。

segments.src: Three details often matter more than the headline result:
segments.tr: 見出しとなる結果よりも、以下の3つの詳細が重要になることがよくあります：

segments.src: - **The size of the margin.** A majority of a few seats is hard to manage, because a handful of absences or defections can sink a bill.
segments.tr: - **議席差の大きさ。** 数議席の過半数は管理が難しく、ほんの数人の欠席や離反で法案が否決される可能性があります。

segments.src: - **The Senate filibuster.** Most legislation needs 60 votes to advance in the Senate, which forces bipartisan deals unless a bill qualifies for a special process.
segments.tr: - **上院のフィリバスター（議事妨害）。** 法案が特別な手続きの対象とならない限り、上院で進行させるにはほとんどの法案で60票が必要となり、超党派の合意が強制されます。

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Whoever chairs the Ways and Means, Finance, Appropriations and Budget committees helps set the agenda, schedule hearings and shape the text of bills.
segments.tr: - **委員会の上層部。** 歳入委員会、財政委員会、歳出委員会、予算委員会の委員長を務める人物が、議題の設定、公聴会のスケジュール作成、法案文面の調整を主導します。

segments.src: ## The Budget and Government Funding
segments.tr: ## 予算と政府資金調達

segments.src: Congress must pass appropriations bills each year to fund federal agencies.
segments.tr: 議会は連邦機関に資金を供給するために毎年歳出法案を可決しなければなりません。

segments.src: When it fails to do so by the start of the fiscal year on October 1, it typically passes a short-term "continuing resolution" to keep the government open, or risks a partial shutdown.
segments.tr: 10月1日の会計年度開始までにそれができない場合、通常は政府閉鎖を回避して政府を開けておくために短期の「継続予算決議（CR）」を可決するか、部分的な政府閉鎖のリスクを冒すことになります。

segments.src: ### What to watch
segments.tr: ### 注目すべきポイント

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **歳出交渉。** 下院と上院は、国防および非国防プログラムの支出レベルについて合意する必要があります。ねじれ議会では多くの場合、期限間際に暫定措置や大規模な包括法案が組み合わされることになります。

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **債務上限。** 議会は定期的に借入上限を引き上げるか一時停止して、財務省がすでに発生した債務を支払えるようにする必要があります。これらの採決は、より広範な予算交渉の機会として繰り返し使われてきました。

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **義務的経費（エンタイトルメント）と赤字。** 社会保障、メディケア、メディケイドは連邦支出の大部分を占めており、国債の利子コストも増加しています。これらのプログラムを変更する提案は政治的に困難であり、広範な合意なしに進むことはめったにありません。

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **予算調整手続き（リコンシリエーション）。** この手続きにより、上院はフィリバスターを回避し、単純過半数で特定の税制および支出措置を可決できます。対象に含めることができる内容には厳格なルールがあり、特定のテーマに対して毎年制限された回数しか使用できません。

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## 税制政策

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: 今後の2年間の税制論争は、どの規定がいつ変更される予定か、そして議員がそれらをどれだけ変更したいかによって形作られます。

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: 税法には特定の期日に失効する多くの時限措置が含まれており、これが議会にとって自然な決定の節目となります。

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### 主な質問

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **延長と失効。** 一連の税制規定が失効を迎えるたびに、議員らはそれらを延長するか、変更するか、あるいは失効させるかを決定しなければなりません。それぞれの選択は、世帯の可処分所得や企業の計画に影響を与えます。

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **コストと財源確保。** 減税は、支出削減やその他の財源によって相殺されない限り、連邦収入を減少させます。超党派の議会予算局（CBO）や税制合同委員会を含む議会の見積もり機関がこれらのコストを試算し、その数字が論争を決定づけることがよくあります。

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **ターゲットを絞った税額控除と所得控除。** 児童関連の控除、企業の即時償却、エネルギーインセンティブの変更など、小規模で超党派の提案は、僅差の議会において抜本的な見直しよりも可決される可能性が高くなります。

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **手続き上の制限。** 超党派の支持を得られない主要な税制法案は一般的にリコンシリエーションに依存することになり、組み込める内容が制限されます。

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: 世帯や小規模事業者への実用的なアドバイスは、提案ではなく、実際に成立した立法に従うことです。

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: 選挙戦中に議論されたアイデアのほとんどは、元の形のまま法律になることはありません。

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## 関税と貿易

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: 貿易政策は行政部が大きな権限を持っているため、特殊です。

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: 議会は関税と外国商業に関する憲法上の権限を持っていますが、いくつかの法令を通じてその権限の多くを大統領に委任しています。

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: その結果、関税政策は税制や支出政策よりも迅速に変更される可能性があります。

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### 議会が依然として貿易に影響を与える方法

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **監督権。** 委員会は公聴会を開催し、文書を要求し、関税のコストと影響について高官を問いただすことができます。

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **立法。** 議員は貿易措置を制限、条件付け、または法制化する法案を提出できますが、そうした措置は大統領の拒否権に直面する可能性があり、これを覆すには両院での3分の2の賛成票が必要です。

de.title: Nach den Zwischenwahlen: Was das neue Machtgleichgewicht für Steuern, Ausgaben und Handel bedeutet

segments.src: With the votes counted, the conversation in Washington shifts from campaigning to governing.
segments.tr: Nachdem die Stimmen ausgezählt sind, verlagert sich das Gespräch in Washington vom Wahlkampf zum Regieren.

segments.src: Elections decide who holds the gavels, but the harder question is what the new Congress can actually pass, and what the president can do without it.
segments.tr: Wahlen entscheiden darüber, wer den Vorsitz innehat, aber die schwierigere Frage ist, was der neue Kongress tatsächlich verabschieden kann und was der Präsident ohne ihn tun kann.

segments.src: This explainer walks through the main levers on the budget, tax policy and tariffs, and why the final shape of the new Congress matters so much for the next two years.
segments.tr: Dieser Erklärungsartikel beleuchtet die wichtigsten Hebel für den Haushalt, die Steuerpolitik und Zölle sowie die Frage, warum die endgültige Zusammensetzung des neuen Kongresses für die nächsten zwei Jahre so wichtig ist.

segments.src: *Note: Final margins, especially in closely divided chambers, can take time to settle.
segments.tr: *Hinweis: Die endgültigen Ergebnisse, insbesondere in knapp besetzten Kammern, können einige Zeit in Anspruch nehmen.

segments.tr: Dieser Artikel konzentriert sich auf die Funktionsweise des Prozesses und nicht auf Vorhersagen; Leser sollten die offiziellen Ergebnisse für die neuesten Sitzzahlen überprüfen.*

segments.src: ## Why the Balance of Power Matters
segments.tr: ## Warum das Machtgleichgewicht wichtig ist

segments.src: Most major economic policy in the United States requires agreement among three parties: the House, the Senate and the White House.
segments.tr: Die meisten wichtigen wirtschaftspolitischen Maßnahmen in den Vereinigten Staaten erfordern eine Einigung zwischen drei Parteien: dem Repräsentantenhaus, dem Senat und dem Weißen Haus.

segments.src: When one party controls all three, legislation can move relatively quickly, though narrow margins still give small groups of lawmakers real leverage.
segments.tr: Wenn eine Partei alle drei kontrolliert, kann die Gesetzgebung relativ schnell vorankommen, obwohl knappe Mehrheiten kleinen Gruppen von Gesetzgebern immer noch echten Einfluss verleihen.

segments.src: When control is split, the typical result is negotiation, delay or gridlock, and a greater reliance on executive action and must-pass deadlines.
segments.tr: Wenn die Kontrolle aufgeteilt ist, ist das typische Ergebnis Verhandlung, Verzögerung oder Stillstand sowie eine stärkere Abhängigkeit von Exekutivmaßnahmen und Fristen, die unbedingt eingehalten werden müssen.

segments.src: Three details often matter more than the headline result:
segments.tr: Drei Details sind oft wichtiger als das Hauptergebnis:

segments.src: - **The size of the margin.** A majority of a few seats is hard to manage, because a handful of absences or defections can sink a bill.
segments.tr: - **Die Größe der Mehrheit.** Eine Mehrheit von wenigen Sitzen ist schwer zu verwalten, da eine Handvoll Abwesenheiten oder Abweichler einen Gesetzentwurf zu Fall bringen können.

segments.src: - **The Senate filibuster.** Most legislation needs 60 votes to advance in the Senate, which forces bipartisan deals unless a bill qualifies for a special process.
segments.tr: - **Der Filibuster im Senat.** Die meisten Gesetze benötigen 60 Stimmen, um im Senat voranzukommen, was parteiübergreifende Vereinbarungen erzwingt, es sei denn, ein Gesetzentwurf qualifiziert sich für ein spezielles Verfahren.

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Whoever chairs the Ways and Means, Finance, Appropriations and Budget committees helps set the agenda, schedule hearings and shape the text of bills.
segments.tr: - **Ausschussführung.** Wer den Vorsitz in den Ausschüssen für Wege und Mittel (Ways and Means), Finanzen, Bewilligungen und Haushalt führt, hilft dabei, die Agenda festzulegen, Anhörungen zu planen und den Text von Gesetzentwürfen zu gestalten.

segments.src: ## The Budget and Government Funding
segments.tr: ## Der Haushalt und die Staatsfinanzierung

segments.src: Congress must pass appropriations bills each year to fund federal agencies.
segments.tr: Der Kongress muss jedes Jahr Bewilligungsgesetze verabschieden, um Bundesbehörden zu finanzieren.

segments.src: When it fails to do so by the start of the fiscal year on October 1, it typically passes a short-term "continuing resolution" to keep the government open, or risks a partial shutdown.
segments.tr: Wenn dies bis zum Beginn des Geschäftsjahres am 1. Oktober nicht gelingt, verabschiedet er normalerweise eine kurzfristige "Resolution zur Fortführung der Finanzierung" (continuing resolution), um die Regierung offen zu halten, oder riskiert einen teilweisen Stillstand (Shutdown).

segments.src: ### What to watch
segments.tr: ### Worauf zu achten ist

segments.src: - **Appropriations negotiations.** The House and Senate must agree on spending levels for defense and non-defense programs. A divided Congress often means stopgap measures and large combined packages near deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Bewilligungsverhandlungen.** Das Repräsentantenhaus und der Senat müssen sich auf die Ausgabenhöhen für Verteidigungs- und Nicht-Verteidigungsprogramme einigen. Ein gespaltener Kongress bedeutet oft Übergangslösungen und große kombinierte Pakete kurz vor Fristablauf.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Periodically, Congress must raise or suspend the borrowing cap so the Treasury can pay obligations already incurred. These votes have repeatedly become occasions for broader budget bargaining.
segments.tr: - **Die Schuldenobergrenze.** Der Kongress muss regelmäßig die Kreditaufnahmeobergrenze anheben oder aussetzen, damit das Finanzministerium bereits eingegangene Verpflichtungen bezahlen kann. Diese Abstimmungen sind wiederholt zu Anlässen für umfassendere Haushaltsverhandlungen geworden.

segments.src: - **Entitlements and deficits.** Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid make up a large share of federal spending, and interest costs on the national debt have grown. Proposals to change these programs are politically difficult and rarely move without broad agreement.
segments.tr: - **Ansprüche und Defizite.** Social Security, Medicare und Medicaid machen einen großen Teil der Bundesausgaben aus, und die Zinskosten für die Staatsverschuldung sind gestiegen. Vorschläge zur Änderung dieser Programme sind politisch schwierig und kommen selten ohne breite Zustimmung voran.

segments.src: - **Budget reconciliation.** This procedure lets the Senate pass certain tax and spending measures with a simple majority, avoiding the filibuster. It comes with strict rules about what can be included, and it can be used only a limited number of times on a given topic each year.
segments.tr: - **Haushaltsabstimmung (Budget Reconciliation).** Dieses Verfahren ermöglicht es dem Senat, bestimmte Steuer- und Ausgabenmaßnahmen mit einfacher Mehrheit zu verabschieden und so den Filibuster zu umgehen. Es ist mit strengen Regeln verbunden, was enthalten sein darf, und kann jedes Jahr nur eine begrenzte Anzahl von Malen zu einem bestimmten Thema verwendet werden.

segments.src: ## Tax Policy
segments.tr: ## Steuerpolitik

segments.src: Tax debates over the next two years will be shaped by which provisions are scheduled to change and how much lawmakers want to alter them.
segments.tr: Die Steuerdebatten der nächsten zwei Jahre werden davon geprägt sein, welche Bestimmungen geändert werden sollen und wie stark die Gesetzgeber sie ändern wollen.

segments.src: Tax law includes many temporary provisions that expire on set dates, which creates natural decision points for Congress.
segments.tr: Das Steuerrecht enthält viele vorübergehende Bestimmungen, die zu festgelegten Terminen auslaufen, was natürliche Entscheidungspunkte für den Kongress schafft.

segments.src: ### Key questions
segments.tr: ### Kernfragen

segments.src: - **Extensions and expirations.** Whenever a set of tax provisions is due to expire, lawmakers must decide whether to extend, modify or let them lapse. Each choice affects household take-home pay and business planning.
segments.tr: - **Verlängerungen und Auslaufen.** Wann immer eine Reihe von Steuerbestimmungen ausläuft, müssen die Gesetzgeber entscheiden, ob sie diese verlängern, ändern oder auslaufen lassen. Jede Wahl beeinflusst das Nettoeinkommen der Haushalte und die Geschäftsplanung.

segments.src: - **Cost and offsets.** Tax cuts reduce federal revenue unless they are offset by spending reductions or other revenue. Congressional scorekeepers, including the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation, estimate these costs, and their numbers often shape the debate.
segments.tr: - **Kosten und Kompensationen.** Steuersenkungen reduzieren die Bundeseinnahmen, es sei denn, sie werden durch Ausgabenkürzungen oder andere Einnahmen ausgeglichen. Die Haushaltsprüfer des Kongresses, einschließlich des überparteilichen Congressional Budget Office und des Joint Committee on Taxation, schätzen diese Kosten, und ihre Zahlen prägen oft die Debatte.

segments.src: - **Targeted credits and deductions.** Smaller, bipartisan proposals, such as changes to child-related credits, business expensing or energy incentives, are more likely to pass in a closely divided Congress than sweeping overhauls.
segments.tr: - **Gezielte Gutschriften und Abzüge.** Kleinere, parteiübergreifende Vorschläge, wie Änderungen bei kinderbezogenen Gutschriften, betrieblichen Ausgaben oder Anreizen für Energie, werden in einem knapp gespaltenen Kongress eher verabschiedet als umfassende Reformen.

segments.src: - **Process limits.** A major tax bill without bipartisan support generally depends on reconciliation, which narrows what can be included.
segments.tr: - **Verfahrensbeschränkungen.** Ein großes Steuergesetz ohne parteiübergreifende Unterstützung hängt im Allgemeinen von der Haushaltsabstimmung (Reconciliation) ab, was den Spielraum dessen, was enthalten sein kann, einschränkt.

segments.src: For households and small businesses, the practical advice is to follow actual enacted legislation rather than proposals.
segments.tr: Für Haushalte und kleine Unternehmen ist der praktische Rat, sich an tatsächlich verabschiedeten Gesetzen zu orientieren und nicht an Vorschlägen.

segments.src: Most ideas discussed during a campaign never become law in their original form.
segments.tr: Die meisten Ideen, die während eines Wahlkampfs diskutiert werden, werden in ihrer ursprünglichen Form nie Gesetz.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and Trade
segments.tr: ## Zölle und Handel

segments.src: Trade policy is unusual because the executive branch holds significant authority.
segments.tr: Die Handelspolitik ist ungewöhnlich, da die Exekutive über erhebliche Befugnisse verfügt.

segments.src: Congress has constitutional power over tariffs and foreign commerce, but it has delegated a great deal of that power to the president through several statutes.
segments.tr: Der Kongress hat verfassungsmäßige Macht über Zölle und Außenhandel, hat aber einen Großteil dieser Macht durch mehrere Gesetze an den Präsidenten delegiert.

segments.src: As a result, tariff policy can change faster than tax or spending policy.
segments.tr: Infolgedessen kann sich die Zollpolitik schneller ändern als die Steuer- oder Ausgabenpolitik.

segments.src: ### How Congress can still influence trade
segments.tr: ### Wie der Kongress den Handel dennoch beeinflussen kann

segments.src: - **Oversight.** Committees can hold hearings, request documents and question officials about the costs and effects of tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Aufsicht.** Ausschüsse können Anhörungen abhalten, Dokumente anfordern und Beamte zu den Kosten und Auswirkungen von Zöllen befragen.

segments.src: - **Legislation.** Lawmakers can propose bills to limit, condition or codify trade actions, though such measures face a possible presidential veto, which requires a two-thirds vote in both chambers to override.
segments.tr: - **Gesetzgebung.** Gesetzgeber können Gesetzentwürfe vorschlagen, um Handelsmaßnahmen zu begrenzen, an Bedingungen zu knüpfen oder zu kodifizieren, obwohl solche Maßnahmen einem möglichen Veto des Präsidenten gegenüberstehen, dessen Überwindung eine Zweidrittelmehrheit in beiden Kammern erfordert.

segments.src: - **Trade agreements.** Congress has a role in approving or implementing certain trade deals and in funding the agencies that enforce trade rules.
segments.tr: - **Handelsabkommen.** Der Kongress spielt eine Rolle bei der Genehmigung oder Umsetzung bestimmter Handelsabkommen und bei der Finanzierung der Behörden, die Handelsregeln durchsetzen.

segments.src: - **Courts.** Legal challenges over the scope of executive tariff authority can also shape outcomes, independent of any vote in Congress.
segments.tr: - **Gerichte.** Rechtliche Anfechtungen bezüglich des Umfangs der exekutiven Zollbefugnisse können ebenfalls Ergebnisse beeinflussen, unabhängig von einer Abstimmung im Kongress.

segments.tr: Ökonomen sind sich im Allgemeinen uneinig darüber, wie groß die Auswirkungen sind und wer sie trägt, was ein Grund dafür ist, dass Handelsdebatten hitzig bleiben.
